“Hayır, üzgünüm, sadece biraz… Pfft!”
“…Şimdiden bir sonrakine geçin,”
Bunu sadece kız arkadaşının isteği üzerine kabul etmesine rağmen, Touya’nın elde ettiği tek şey sonunda kahkahası oldu. Omuzları düştü, pencereye doğru yürüdü.
“Aaah, kusura bakma Touya! Hayır, ımm, kasların burada gerçekten iyi görünüyor? Sanırım sana yakışıyor, gerçekten!” diye bağırdı Chisaki, umutsuzca onu takip etmek için acele ederek.
Onun hemen ardından el sanatları kulübü sunumu bir sonraki duyuruyla devam etti.
“İki numaralı giriş ooo! Adalet sevimlidir! Başka hiçbir şeyin önemi yok! Gotik lolita savaşçısı Masachika Kuze-kun!”
Alisa duyurusu üzerine irkilerek sırtını dikleştirirken kapı açıldı… uzun gümüş rengi bir peruk ve gotik bir lolita elbise giyen Masachika ortaya çıktı.

İnanılmaz derecede cömert ve gösterişliydi, tamamen siyah beyazdı: klasik, geleneksel yoldan doğrudan gitmenin özü. Porselen kadar beyaz teni, elbisenin siyahı üzerinde göze çarpıyordu ve uzun kirpikleri melankoliyle aşağıya doğru iniyordu.
El sanatları kulübü üyeleri bile yardım edemedi ama…
“Harika gidiyorsun, harika gidiyorsun!”
“Fena değil! Hiç de fena değil!”
“Gözlerinizi kısarak baktığınız sürece zar zor başarılı oluyor!”
“Eğer ona yeterince ışık tutarsak biçimde bunu başaracağı kesindir!”
“Beni övmüyorsun değil mi!?” Masachika, önüne çıkan acı verici derecede dürüst değerlendirmelerle yüzleşerek geri çekildi.
Ama yine de… sonucu açıklamak gerçekten çok zordu.
“Vay be… Bu beklediğimden de şüpheli~,” diye fısıldadı Yuki alçaktan. “Evet~”

Mangadan farklı olarak, o kadar makyaj yaptıktan sonra aynaya bakıp “Bu… ben mi…?” ya da buna benzer bir şeyle tamamen güzel bir kıza dönüştüğü bir an yoktu. Cildi düzgünce bakımlıydı elbette. Yüzündeki erkeksi hatlar yumuşatılmış, yanaklarına biraz allık uygulanmış ve kirpikleri daha da kalınlaştırılmıştı.

Ve yine de, o zaman bile, ancak “Ah, o artık bir kız… Hayır, aslında pek beceremedi, değil mi?” gibi bir tepkiyle verebileceğiniz türden bir sonuç elde etmişlerdi. ile. Dantel ağırlıklı gotik lolita elbisesi fiziğini bir dereceye kadar gizlese bile yine de bu duygudan kurtulamıyordunuz. Bu noktada, muhtemelen temelde crossdressing’e hiç uygun değildi.
“Evet~. Cildi pürüzsüz, bu yüzden belki onunla çok şey yapabiliriz diye düşündüm, ama… evet.”
“Bu daha çok bir erkek komedyenin teni için kıyafet değiştirmesi seviyesinde, sanırım, değil mi?”
“Hepiniz ciddi eleştiriyi artık bırakabilir misiniz…?” Masachika kendi kendine homurdandı. “Öyle dayanılmaz ki. Onca çabadan sonra da. Peki bunun kime faydası var? Cidden…”
İçeri girilmesi zor kıyafeti içinde çabalayarak pencereye doğru yürüdü.
Ve daha sonra…
“Haaah, ah! Eeeeeek~♡! Çok güzel♡!” Ait olduğu kişi aniden cümlelerine geri dönmüş gibi, gecikmeli de olsa şuruplu bir ses çınladı.
Herkes şok içinde etrafa bakındı. Etrafındaki bakışlara kesinlikle aldırış etmeyen Maria, kalpleri resmen başından uçup gidecek şekilde Masachika’ya doğru koştu.
“Eeek! Gerçekten çok tatlısın♡”

“Hayır, bu kadar çok övülmek beni… açıkçası mutlu olup olmamam hakkında şüpheye düşürüyor…” ikincisi alaycı bir gülümseme bıraktı, birincisi yanağını onunkine bastırırken birbiri ardına keyif dolu ciyaklamalar çıkararak onunla selfieler çekti.
Ve böylece, çapraz giyinmiş Masachika gelişigüzel belgelenmişti.
Çevrelerindekiler istemsizce “”Ehhh…“” diye geri çekilerek söylendiler.
Alisa bile kız kardeşinin hassasiyetlerinden biraz rahatsız duruyordu.

“Artık sonunda yalnızca bir kişi kaldı!” el sanatları kulübü başkanı boğazını temizledikten sonra dramatik biçimde sesini yükselterek duyurdu. “Giriş sayısı… üç! Bir numaralı favorimiz! Büyülü kız, Scarlet-chaaaaan!”

Daha sonra kapı açıldı… ve içeri gülünç derecede uzun boylu, büyülü bir kız girdi, galiba duyulabilir bir ta-da☆ sesinin eşlik ettiği bir poz verdi, kırmızı çift kuyrukları bir vızıltıyla sallanıyordu. Fırfırlı, kabarık eteğinin altından göz kamaştırıcı derecede soluk bacaklar uzanıyordu (yeni tıraş edilmiş), saf beyaz diz boyu pantolonlara bürünmüştü.
Fiziğinin “pembe” yerine daha çocuksu “mavi” hislere yönelmesinin yanı sıra, çok uzun olmasıyla gurur duyan şey, oldukça ikna edici ve güzel, büyülü bir kızdan başka bir şey değildi.
“Cuuuteee!”
“Vay, ne kadar uzun!”
“Ne güzel bacaklar! Dur, hey, bu etek çok kısa!”
“Bu işe yarıyor! Bu kesinlikle işe yarıyor!”
El sanatları kulübü üyelerinin tepkileri önceki ikisinden açıkça farklıydı. Crossdresser’ın kendisi de ne kadar kendini adamış durumdaydı.
“Aman Tanrım, şaşırtıcı biçimde hala bunu başarabiliyorsun, değil mi?” saygıdeğer kuzeni -ki bu aşırı bağlılığının sebebi kesinlikle kendisiydi- kollarını kavuşturmuş, arkaya doğru durarak konuştu.
“Vay be…” dedi Alisa, Yuusho’nun daha önce Masachika’ya kıyasla ne kadar düzgün giyinmiş olmasından yarı etkilenmiş, yarı ürkmüştü.
“Dostum, buna kendi tarzında tepki vermek zor…” diye fısıldadı Yuki, aynı ifadeyi paylaşarak.
Aoi’ye gelince…
“Brüt.”
Her zamanki gibi açık sözlü.
“Scarlet-chan, şu tarafa bak!”
“Fotoğraf çekebilir miyim!?”
“Vay be, çok seksi!”
El sanatları kulübü üyelerinin bir cosplay fotoğraf çekimindeymiş gibi heyecanlandığını göz ucuyla gören Alisa, odanın köşesinde hâlâ Maria’ya sarılı halde Masachika’ya doğru yürüdü.
“Masha” diye seslendi. “Bunu daha ne kadar sürdürmeyi planlıyorsun?”
“Ehhh~? Ama o çok tatlı~”
“O nasıl…?”
“Gerçekten bunu bu kadar açıkça benim önümde mi söyleyeceksin?” Masachika şikayet ederek Alisa’nın ona tekrar yakından bakmasını sağladı.
en: The following Saturday.
A day which, by chance, all the student council members, along with Sumire, Yuusho, and Aoi—a large ten people in total—had gathered in the student council office, the atmosphere heavy with deadlock.

Amidst such a tense atmosphere, Touya—who hadn’t participated in the actual investigation himself, but had come to check on things as the person responsible for the student assembly—was the first to break the silence.
“Haaah,” he sighed. “…So, no one was able to find anyone who fit the bill in the end. That’s what you guys are saying?”

“That we are, hm?” Masachika confirmed. “I mean, worst case scenario, there’s also the possibility that it could’ve been someone from outside school, or maybe even a student from the junior high… It can’t be helped if it just can’t be helped, I guess.”

Considering the level of security in this school, the chance of it being a complete outsider was low. But still, that didn’t mean it was entirely impossible for a student from the school’s junior high to come into the high school building, change into a high school uniform, and pretend to be a second-year. That was something they all had considered before the investigation had truly begun, but expanding the search to include the junior high would simply just increase the number of suspects they had to check in with by far too much, so that line of inquiry had been ruled out.
I mean, it’s not like we really intended to seriously hunt down the perp to begin with anyway…

But of course, this still regarded Nonoa’s crucial pawn… If anything, she might as well be practically her right hand, so there was no denying that there was still a desire to keep an eye on such a mysterious female student. But more than that, for Masachika, making sure that no one else captured her was more important. In fact, given that both Yuki and the disciplinary committee had still yet to get to her, he actually even thought that this was the perfect point to just call off the whole investigation altogether.
And it’s probably the same for Yuki too, he contemplated.

Yuki had originally wanted to catch the mysterious girl because the already existing circumstantial evidence had put her in a position where she herself was being suspected of being the mastermind. But now, with the investigation having progressed to the point where she realized that there were far fewer people suspecting her than she had initially anticipated, she didn’t really have much reason left to desperately pursue who it truly was.
So that leaves the disciplinary committee led by Sarashina-senpai, huh…? Masachika deduced. Now then, I wonder just how we’re gonna get them to call off their investigation?
Just as he was secretly thinking that, the very person in question, Chisaki, suddenly raised her voice as if to change the mood.
“Ahhh~, geez! Alright! Let’s at least compare our intel for now!” she declared. “Each of you, who did you all investigate? What were your impressions of them?”
At her request, Maachika, Alisa, Yuki, and Ayano each shared who they had looked into, including their impressions.
After jotting all that information on the whiteboard, Chisaki then rested her chin on one hand as she fell into thought.
“Um, Sarashina-senpai,” Masachika then spoke up.
“Hm? What’s up?”

“Right, to be honest, I think the chances of finding our perp here’s pretty low even if we were to continue this investigation. And more than that, I’m actually more worried about the side effect that’s come from it…”
“The side effect?”
“Right. It’s actually looking like news of this investigation of ours spreading among the students has started something like a manhunt between them…”
And this wasn’t really a lie.

Sure, though what Masachika had actually seen was just nothing more than female students playfully poking at each other with teasing like, “You’re the mastermind, aren’t youuu~?” and responses like “Ehhh~? No wayyy~,” there was no guarantee it wouldn’t escalate from the level it was at now.

“It’s still fine as long as it stays as just jokes, sure. But if our investigation drags on like this, then I’m scared that we’ll just be stirring suspicion and paranoia among the students, and that’ll lead to false accusations—or maybe even bullying—toward the ones we’ve already and will investigate,” he reasoned.
“That’s…”

In truth, a failure shared amongst everyone involved in this whole investigation. This world was full of people who’d spread baseless rumors and treat someone like a criminal just because the police had come to question them, after all. Had they truly cared about protecting the female suspects they had investigated, then they should have absolutely kept it a secret that they were under suspicion from the get go.
“I mean, I don’t intend to let any bullying happen as long as I’m around…” Chisaki remarked. “But that’s definitely quite a problem, right…?”
“Isn’t it? I really think it’s better we try to settle things before the whole situation gets blown out of proportion.”
“Hmm~. And specifically?”

“The smoothest way out I can think of would just be to say that we’ve caught someone matching the perp’s description, but then, like, say we had to release them due to insufficient evidence, I guess?” Masachika suggested. “That way, we don’t have to specify who it was, and people’s interests should wane away once they hear that they’ve been caught, amirite? Plus, if we set the length of their ‘interrogation’ to be longer, after being caught by you guys at the disciplinary committee, of course, then that directly serves as an alibi or proof of innocence for the other students we’ve already gotten to.”
“I see… Hmm~. But saying we caught someone when we didn’t is…”

“If we do catch the real perp later, then you can just say that the whole thing ’bout capturing the perp before had been a false flag, simply meant to make the real perp lower their guard, y’know? Because above all else, shouldn’t our top priority be preventing any innocent students from being suspected here?”
“Nnngh~~~… nngh~~~~”
Groaning in thought at Masachika’s smooth persuasion, Chisaki finally nodded after a brief moment.
“…Alright. We’ll go with Kuze-kun’s plan.”
“Onee-sama!” Sumire exclaimed, immediately protesting. “You’re really giving up on capturing the culprit after only a day and a half of investigation!?
“It really just can’t be helped… We’ve lost this the moment we failed to catch them early on. Oh well, let’s call it settled by publicizing the culprit’s description and issuing a warning.”
“…I humbly acknowledge,” Sumire reluctantly accepted, ensuring to maintain her elegant, archaic tone.
With that, Masachika struck a fist pump in his heart.
Alright, with this, the disciplinary committee has called off their investigation too. Nonoa’s betrayal’s no longer coming to light.

Still, just to be sure, he took a peek at Alisa’s expression. He had explained beforehand that this was the direction he had intended to steer things toward, in order to ensure she wouldn’t be dissatisfied…
Or so he thought. At that exact moment, Alisa raised her hand.
“I’m sorry. About that, could we make it so that Kimishima-san is the one who ‘catches’ this ‘culprit’?”
“Huh?” Masachika uttered in surprise.
“Alya-san?”

Both Yuki and Ayano were also taken aback by her unexpected statement, which might have well been an act like throwing a bone to the enemy. However, with no hesitation caught in her unwavering expression, Alisa apologized to Masachika through her eyes before continuing.

“This whole matter didn’t escalate thanks to you, Kimishima-san,” she said, turning her gaze toward Ayano. “I believe we should, in some form or another, at least give you proper recognition for that.”
It was a proposal declared with a proud figure, with Alisa asserting herself with such a commanding presence that even Chisaki and Sumire could only stare in surprise, as if overwhelmed.
“O-ohhh, yeah, that’s right,” the latter then spoke after a few moments, albeit with a slightly drifting gaze. “Let’s go with that, then?”
“If you’re saying so, Alya-san…” Yuki agreed. “That’s alright, right? Ayano.”
“Yes.”
Seeing Ayano nod, Touya then lightly cleared his throat.
“Alright, got it. In that case, I’ll make that announcement on behalf of the student council. Right then, specifically—”
“Ah, Prez, could you hold on for a moment?” Yuki raised her hand sharply just then, her unexpected move causing Masachika to raise his guard slightly.
“What’s the matter, Suou?”
“My apologies for interrupting you, Prez. I have no objection to that decision either; however, there’s one more thing I’d like to investigate before that.”
“Hm? What?” Chisaki asked in Touya’s place, prompting Yuki to smile sweetly before she continued.
“Yes, there’s something I thought to myself after listening to Masachika-kun and Alya-san earlier,” she proclaimed.
“Eh?”
Watching Alisa frown in confusion, Yuki then smiled meaningfully.
“They had mentioned the drama club as a group full of people skilled at makeup… But if we’re talking about that, then there’s another very promising club in question, am I not right?”
It was at that moment that Chisaki’s expression turned grim, seemingly being the first to realize what she was getting at.
“You don’t mean… the handicrafts club?”
“Yes! Exactly! Don’t you think they’re worth investigating?”
And although both Sumire and Alisa seemed to reluctantly agree with such a suggestion… their reactions were hesitant.

Certainly, the handicrafts club’s makeup skills were very much exceptional. But still, with Masachika and Alisa personally—and Chisaki and Sumire as members of the disciplinary committee—knowing the handicrafts club well, they just simply couldn’t picture them being involved in some strange conspiracy.
Plus, simply put, they were just a group they did not want to get involved with.
Because they were scary.
“Well, I get what you’re saying, Yuki-chan, but…”
“Please wait. There’s still more to it,” Yuki pressed on in response to Chisaki’s clearly unenthusiastic voice.
“Earlier, Masachika-kun suggested that it’s possible that our culprit might be someone from the junior high… But aside from that, don’t you think that there’s another possibility as well?”
“…You mean a uni student?” Chisaki asked, tilting her head.
“If someone younger was a possibility, then someone older could be possible as well,” her tone practically conveyed.
Yet… all Yuki did was shake her head with a bewitching smile in response.
“No, that’s not it…” she refuted. “A man crossdressing as a woman. That’s a possibility too, you know?”

At her words, time froze for several seconds. As the eight others besides Yuki and Ayano all stood there with their mouths slightly agape, frozen in place, Yuki then honed her gaze on Masachika, Touya, and Yuusho.

“Don’t you think it’s a possibility worth verifying?” she suggested right as she did. “About just how close a crossdressing guy can get to being a real woman…? And just as it happens, not only does the handicrafts club have outfits, they have wigs too.”
It was finally at this point that Masachika finally realized her aim.
Th-this girl…!!!
Investigating the handicrafts club was just an excuse. It was nothing but an opportunity for her to make the three of them crossdress.
You little shiiiit!! You’ve got zero intentions on seriously investigating this to start with, huh!? he screamed inwardly at his little sister, whose eyes clearly held a look of delight.
And just as he did, Maria clapped her hands together.
“Wooow!” she exclaimed. “That does sound great, riiight~? It sounds fun!”
“I ain’t doing it, okay!?” Masachika snapped, raising his voice in a bid to not lose to his senior’s cheerful smile.
And yet, all the girls ignored him as if they hadn’t heard a single thing.
“Oh I see… There’s some truth to that, hm?” Chisaki agreed.
“No, there ain’t even an ounce of it here, y’know?” Masachika quipped.
“C-calm down, Chisaki. Come back to your senses,” Touya pleaded as his girlfriend stared at him with glittering eyes.
“Hey, Yuusho-san,” Sumire perked up, honed in at her cousin with a sadistic smile. “I, for one, would like to see Scarlet-chan again. It’s been a long while, I’ll have you know.”
“Now that’s a name I’ve got no clue about,” Masachika quipped yet again.
“Ne-nee-san…” Yuusho protested.
“Huh? Kiryuuin, you had a thing for crossdressing?” Aoi asked, looking down at him with eyes brimming with nothing but contempt. “Gross.”
“No, wait a sec, Vice Prez! I never did, you know!?”
“Masachika-kun. I think sacrificing yourself for the sake of the investigation would be beautiful, you see,” Yuki reasoned, attempting to gently persuade her brother with a soft smile.
“That ain’t something the one making the sacrifice should say, y’know that, riiight!?”
Meanwhile, Ayano’s eyes fluttered with a faint glimmer of expectation.
“Ayano! Say something, will you!?” Masachika begged in response. “A-Alya!”
With his retreat being slowly steadily cut off, he then called out the name of the last remaining person who held on to a shred of conscience: his partner.
And yet…
“Masachika-kun… Testing this possibility is very important, I think.”
It was a line of such utter seriousness, in spite of the clear amusement in her eyes.
“Why the hell are you getting into it too!? Stop screwing about! I ain’t staying here any longer! I’m going home!”
Unable to endure the encirclement of girls harboring nothing but twisted desires, Masachika bolted from the spot.
“Please excuse uuuus~” Chisaki called out.
“Yeeees~…” came a response. “Wait, Chisaki Sarashina!? Wh-what d’you want!? We haven’t done anything today, y’know!?”
“That’s the same excuse you always give though, amirite…? Well, whatever. I’ve got a little favor to ask today, okay…?”
“A favor…?”

Having been welcomed with gazes on max alert the moment she appeared at the handicrafts clubroom, Chisaki gave a wry smile and, with her thumb, gestured toward Touya and Yuusho behind her, and Masachika as well. He had a lifeless look in his eyes as the two firmly grabbed him from either side, as if to say “You’re not getting away.”
“There’s a certain test we’d like to conduct, you see,” Chisaki explained. “Could you try having these three seriously crossdress just once?”
In an instant, the gazes of the handicrafts club members—which had once been full of wariness—all gleamed sharply at once.
“Ohhh. Crossdressing, you say?”
“It’s been a while since we’ve had this…”
“Finally, customers worth the effort…!”
Enveloped in some sort of ominous aura, the handicrafts club members slowly rose, surrounding the three boys, immediately sizing them up.
“Mm-hmm, mm-hmm. A body built like a brick wall, completely unsuited for crossdressing, and a very manly face… But that’s exactly what makes it great!”
“Just as I thought. Shall we go with a dreamy-cute outfit to make it super intense?”
“No, we could also deliberately play it safe with a tight sailor uniform…”
“Kiryuuin-san would probably look the best in crossdressing, hm? He’s got such a pretty face.”
“Hmm~, it feels like anything would look good on him, so it’s ironically hard to choose…”
“Still, he’ll be worth the effort to transform!”
“Kuze-kun’s gonna be the real test of our skills among them, amirite…?”
“But he’ll really transform with a full face of makeup. You think so too, right?”
“I’m somehow starting to get a li’l excited here.”
With the handicrafts club members fully motivated before they knew it, the three boys were each dragged off to their separate spaces, their uniforms promptly being stripped off.

Having already tried to escape earlier, restrained by Yuki and Ayano and persuaded—no, threatened—by Touya and Yuusho, insinuating if he was planning on running off on his own, Masachika had long already abandoned his sense of self. Now withered away to a state of resigned surrender, he had his blazer stripped off by the handicrafts club members.
Watching that scene, Alisa—who until then had an expression mixed in a sense of twenty percent apology, thirty percent curiosity, and fifty percent sadism—began to grow restless.
“Eh? Eh?” she stuttered in a climbing voice. “No way, the female members are the ones changing them…?”
“Alya-san?” Yuki called out to her in a tone that practically asked for the point of bringing such a concern up now.
However, the very girl she called out to didn’t look to be in any state to respond.
“N-noooo… Don’t… touch him all familiarly like that…”
“No, aren’t they just taking measurements?”
【Even I haven’t touched him like that…】
“Sorry? What was that?”

Having forgotten that her older sister was present as well, Alisa slipped into a Russian whisper without thinking. And yet, that very sister of hers, Maria, was also staring at Masachika, her already large eyes gaping even wider and wider.
“Wa-wah!” she stammered with both hands covering her mouth, her face a bright red, also clearly in no state to worry about anything else either. “Aah, aaaaah…!”

Oh, what’s this? Some kinda new NTR? Yuki jested mentally, giving the both of them a look mixed with exasperation and curiosity as she could only watch Masachika being handled by the female club members with absolutely no restraint, flailing her hands in restless agitation.
Could it be… I’ll get to see Alisa lose her cool out of jealousy here?
Or so Yuki thought…
Because right before Alisa could explode, Chisaki reached her limit first.
“Waaaaiiit a seeeec!!” she cried out. “I never said you could cling all over Touya like thaaaat!!”
Leaping forward as if to pounce, she plunged right in between the handicraft club members, sweeping both her arms wide to part the tide of girls aside and snatch Touya away from them.
“Keep your contact to the minimum!” she demanded, glaring around sharply as she pointed at them with a snap. “Changing happens in separate rooms! Non-negotiable!!!”
“““’Kaaaaaay~”””

At the disciplinary committee president’s decree, the handicrafts club members reluctantly dispersed themselves from the three boys. Seeing that, Alisa, and… Maria secretly as well, breathed sighs of relief.
Meanwhile, Yuusho glanced toward Sumire, as if expecting a similar reaction from her…
However…
“Ah, Kiryuuin-senpai. Your leg hair…” a handicrafts club member called out.
“Shaving it all off is perfectly fine, of course,” Sumire told her.
It was a green light given with absolutely zero hesitation: a casual seizure of complete authority over the life and death of her cousin’s leg hair.
Yuusho could only quietly look away in response.
Oh, he’s not crying here or anything, by the way. He’s a boy, after all. Sure, he was about to be dressed as a girl, but…
Ah, that’s just sweat coming out of his eyes there.
And so, about an hour later.

Alisa and others, who had been sent outside midway through, reentered the handicrafts clubroom, the club president having called for them. Stationed in front of the storage room where the costumes were kept, she then began her announcement.
“Ladieees aaaaand ladies!” she boomed into a nonexistent, imaginary microphone. “Thank you all for gathering, fair maidens. Allow me to present… a fashion show of three gentlemeeen~! Let it begin!”

At her words, the handicrafts club members, sitting with knees tucked to their chests, burst into applause and cheers all at once. Carried along by their enthusiasm, Alisa and the others gave a light round of claps as well, standing from behind.
“Now then, let’s get started at once! Entry number one! The sexy boss, Touya Kenzaki-san!!!”
With an audible click, the door to the adjacent room swung open, and Touya appeared.
…With no makeup whatsoever.
His hair was untouched as well, yet all he wore was nothing but an extremely tight china dress.
“““Whoa, that’s brutual!!!”””
“Physically brutal!”
“Visually brutal too!”
“It’s great! It’s just way too much!”
“It’s downright criminal, I tell ya!”
Relentless cheers (?) rained down from the club members as Touya walked forward proudly before them, chest puffed out as if he had already gone full circle and accepted his fate.

From the deep slit of his china dress—its symbolic embodiment—peeked his thick, hairy leg. His arms, extending outward from its sleeveless openings, were just as thick. Its bodice was stretched taut (by his pectorals).
“W-wait a sec! You said you’d seriously crossdress him, right!?” Chisaki protested with a restrained laugh, unable to hold back.
The handicraft club members, specifically a few who’d presumably been in charge of Touya’s crossdressing, then turned around to her and gave wry smiles.
“No, I mean, something like this just has a better charm when enjoyed as-is…” one of them explained, referring to Touya himself.
“And also, if we’re being serious, there just weren’t any female outfits that fit his body type…” another reasoned.
“This one too, actually. The zipper won’t zip; we had to close the back with safety pins, didn’t we, right?”
At those words, Touya turned around. And sure enough, they had given up with zipping it closed, with the dress being held together by safety pins providing the bare minimum of support instead.
His well-defined trapezius peeked out from the smooth satin fabric that shined with a beautiful luster.
“Pfft!” Chisaki chuckled.
“Chisaki!? That actually kinda stings, you know!?”
“No, sorry, it’s just a little… Pfft!”
“…Just move on to the next one already,”
Despite only agreeing to do this at his girlfriend’s request, all Touya got out of it was her laughter in the end. Shoulders slumped, he trudged over to the window.
“Aaaah, sorry, Touya! No, um, your muscles actually look good here? I think it suits you, really!” Chisaki exclaimed, hurrying over to desperately follow up.
Right after she did, the handicrafts club present resumed with the next announcement.
“Entry number twooo! Cute is justice! Nothing else matters! The gothic lolita warrior, Masachika Kuze-kun!!!”
As Alisa straightened her back with a jolt at her announcement, the door opened… revealing Masachika, donning a long silver wig and a gothic lolita dress.

It was incredibly lavish and frilly, in complete black and white: the very essence of going straight down the classic, traditional path. His skin, as white as porcelain, stood out against the black of the dress, and his long eyelashes cast down in melancholy.
Even the handicrafts club members couldn’t help but…
“You’re doin’ great, you’re doin’ great!”
“Not bad! Not bad at all!”
“It barely pulls off as long as you squint!”
“It’ll somehow manage for sure if we just blast enough light on him!”
“You’re not praising me, are ya!?” Masachika snapped back, facing the painfully honest evaluations thrown his way.
But still… the result was just so honestly hard to describe.
“Whoa… This is even more iffy than I expected~,” Yuki whispered from under her breath. “Yiiikes~”

Unlike in manga, there really was just no moment where he’d look into a mirror after putting on all that makeup and go, “Is this… me…?”, or something like that, turning into a completely beautiful girl. His skin had been properly done up, sure. The masculine contours on his face had been softened, they’d applied some blush to his cheeks, and his eyelashes were even thickened. And yet, even then, they had ended up with the sort of result you could only react with something like “Oh, he’s a girl now… No, actually, he’s not really pulling it off, huh?” to. Even with the lace-heavy gothic lolita dress hiding his physique to some extent, you still just couldn’t shake off the feeling. At this point, he was probably just fundamentally not suited for crossdressing at all.
“Yeaaah~. His skin’s smooth, so I thought that maybe we could just do a lot with it, but… yeah.”
“It’s more around the level of a male comedian crossdressing for a skin, I guess, right?”
“Could you all just stop with the serious critique already…?” Masachika grumbled to himself. “So unbearable. After all that effort too. Like, who the hell does this even benefit? Seriously…”
He trudged toward the window, struggling in the hard-to-walk-in outfit.
And then…
“Haaah, ah! Eeeeeek~♡! So cuuuteee♡!” a syrupy voice rang out, albeit belatedly, as if who it belonged to had suddenly snapped back to their sentences.
Everybody whipped around in shock. Paying absolutely no mind whatsoever to the stares all around her, Maria—with hearts practically flying off from her head—ran up to Masachika.
“Eeek! You’re really cuuuteee♡”

“No, being praised so highly like that makes me feel… honestly iffy about whether I should be happy or not…” the latter let out a wry smile, met with the former pressing her cheek against his as she let out delighted squeals after another, taking selfies with him.
And just like that, crossdressed Masachika had casually been documented.
“““Ehhh…””” those around them involuntarily uttered, recoiling.
Even Alisa looked slightly put off by her sister’s sensibilities.

“Now then, at last, only one remains!” the handicrafts club president announced, raising her voice dramatically after clearing her throat. “Entry numbeeeeer… three! Our number one favorite! Magical girl, Scarlet-chaaaaan!!!”

The door then opened… and in came a ridiculously tall magical girl, striking a pose that might as well have been accompanied by an audible ta-da☆, his red twin-tails swaying with a swoosh. From beneath his frilly, fluffy skirt extended dazzlingly pale legs (freshly shaved), clad in pure white knee-highs. Aside from his physique leaning toward more boyish “blue” vibes than “pink,” being way too tall, what stood proud was nothing but a fairly convincing and beautiful magical girl.
“Cuuuteee!!”
“Whoa, so tall!”
“What beautiful legs! Wait, hey, that skirt’s too short!”
“This works! This totally works!”
The reactions from the handicrafts club members were clearly different from the previous two. So was how completely committed the crossdresser himself was.
“Oh my, you can surprisingly still pull it off, can you not?” his esteemed cousin—who was surely the cause for his over-the-top commitment—remarked with her arms folded, standing towards the back.
“Whoa…” Alisa uttered, half impressed and half put off with how properly presentable of a level Yuusho had been dressed compared to Masachika earlier.
“Man, this one’s hard to react to in its own way…” Yuki whispered, sharing the same expression.
As for Aoi…
“Gross.”
Blunt as ever.
“Scarlet-chan, look this wayyy!”
“Can I take a pic!?”
“Woooow, so sexyyy!”

Seeing the handicraft club members getting all excited as if they were at some cosplay photoshoot from the corner of her eye, Alisa walked over to Masachika, still entwined to Maria in the corner of the room.
“Masha,” she called out. “How long are you planning to keep this up?”
“Ehhh~? But he’s sooo cuuute~”
“Just how is he…?”
“You’re really gonna say that so clearly right in front of me?” Masachika complained, prompting Alisa to look at him again from up close.

tr: “…Evet, sevimli değil, değil mi?”
Onun izlenimi pek değişmedi. En iyi ihtimalle söyleyebildiği tek şey, “Elinden gelenin en iyisini yaptın, hm?” gibi bir şeydi.
“Ehhh~? Alya-chan, çok kötüsün~,” diye itiraz etti Maria. “Sevimli olmaya çalışırken gösterdiği çaba onu sevimli yapan şeyin bir parçası, değil mi~?”
“Hayır Masha, böyle hissetmen seni azınlıkta bırakıyor.”
“Yani evet, bunu ben bile biliyorum ama biliyorsun… bu kadar yolu beni görmek için gelmene gerek yok…” diye belirtti Masachika.
Onun bu şekilde somurttuğunu çok nadir gören bir manzarayı gören Alisa, bakışlarını biraz başka tarafa kaydırmadan önce hafif, alaycı bir gülümseme attı.
[Çıplak yüzün daha da çekici, ] diye mırıldandı alçaktan.
“Yine mi geldin Alya-chan?”
“Hiçbir şey!”

Neredeyse kız kardeşi tarafından yakalanacak olan Alisa, eylemlerini örtbas etmek amacıyla hızla yüzünü daha da keskin biçimde çevirdi. Hemen ardından, bu noktaya kadar tamamen ifadesiz olan Masachika dudaklarını muzip bir sırıtışla kıvırdı.
“Ha!? Ne!? Alya, sen de karşı cinsin kıyafetlerini giymeyi denemek istediğini mi söylüyorsun!?” diye bağırdı, kasıtlı olarak sözlerini yanlış anladı.
Onun ani patlaması üzerine, kendini tamamen Scarlet-chan’a kaptırmış olan tüm el sanatları kulübü üyeleri, hep birlikte başlarını ona çevirdi.
“Eee!”

Alisa, gözleri tamamen açıkça başlarını ona doğru çeviren her kızın biraz utanç verici görüntüsü karşısında hafif bir çığlık atan Alisa, içgüdüsel olarak geri adım attı. Etrafında dönerek sırıtan ortağına keskin bir bakış attı, ardından durumu fiziksel olarak kontrol edebilen tek kişiye, Chisaki’ye döndü.
Fakat…
“Bir erkek gibi kıyafet değiştirmek, ha…?”
“Ee, Touya…?” Chisaki, başkanın sözlerine yanıt olarak seslendi. “Hım, acaba… beni çapraz giyinirken görmek ister misin?”
“Hmm. Yani öyle olmadığımı söylersem yalan söylemiş olurum… Hayır, açıkçası ilgileniyorum.”
“Touya… Peki, belki… denemeli miyim?”

Görünen o ki, çok güvenilir başkan yardımcıları ve disiplin kurulunun saygın başkanı, erkek arkadaşıyla flört etmekle fazlasıyla meşguldü. Ve gemiye bindikten sonra el sanatları kulübündeki bu grubu durdurmak mümkün değildi.
“Tamam o zaman. Madem şansımız var, geri kalanınız da!” bir üye bu fırsatın hemen üzerine atladığını belirtti.
“Yani elimizde Kujou kardeşler var, Kiryuuin-san ve Suou-san… Bir dakika, ha? Peki ya Kimishima-san ve Tsukamoto-san?” dedi bir başkası Ayano ve Aoi’nin ortadan kayboluşuna işaret ederek.
“Ah, Kimishima-san var! Tsukamoto-san nerede?”
“Eh, kaçtı mı? Bu ne zaman oldu!?”

Başlangıçta duvarın yanında arka planda kaybolan Ayano’nun da hızla olaya dahil olmasıyla, bu kez karşı cinsin kıyafetlerini giyecek olanların kız olması kararlaştırıldı. Elbette hızlı bir kaçış gerçekleştiren ve “Bunun gibi bir dizi güzelliğin yanında duruyorum!” diyen Aoi dışında hepsi.
“Vay canına, bu figür her zamanki gibi muhteşem… Gerçekten orantıların tanrıçası…”
“Ha? Kujou-san… göğsün yine biraz mı büyüdü?”
“Sadece bu değil, kalçaları da büyümüş gibi görünüyor…”
“Ama yine de beli aynı… Nasıl?”
“Çünkü o bir tanrı.”
“Ah, görüyorum~”
Kim bilir kaç kez Alisa kendisini el sanatları kulübü üyeleri tarafından kuşatılmış halde buldu ve ona karşı koymak için kıyafet üstüne kıyafet getiriyordu.
“Ohhh~, bu biraz fazla kısa, ha~? Sıradaki!”
“Şimdilik önce göğsünü düzleştirebilir miyiz? Bu olur mu~?”
“Yapabiliriz, aptal. Göğsünü olduğu gibi bırak, göğsünü bırak.”
“Ha? Sağır falan mısın? Buna kelimenin tam anlamıyla crossdressing deniyor. Crossdressing! Göğsünü koruyan kadın crossdresser, erkek kıyafetleri giyen bir kadından başka bir şey değil, değil mi!?”
“Saçmalamayı kes! Ona erkek kıyafetleri giydirmenin asıl amacı, kocaman göğüslerinin onları aşağıdan yukarıya doğru itmesidir, bu bir erkekle elde edemeyeceğin bir şey!”

“Bana havlama, seni pislik. Göğsünü tamamen dümdüz etmek, ’Altında gerçekten kocaman göğüsleri olabilir mi?’ gibi hayal gücüne yer açar, anlıyor musun? Büyük göğüslerin üzerine anında atlayacak olan tam sığ aptal. Git gravür idolüne falan bak ve şimdiden otuzbir çek.”
“Başkan! H-bardaklar! Düzleşmiyorlar!”
“Ne!? Vazgeçme! Onları zorla içeri al!”
“B-bu hiç iyi değil! Zorluyor ba-wa-waaaargh!”
“İşte, gördün mü!? Göğüslerin tanrıçası konuştu: kocaman göğüslerim ezilmeyecek!”
Bu adamlar riskli… diye düşündü Alisa, el sanatları kulübü üyelerinin başka dünyaya ait bir tartışma yüzünden heyecanlanıp uzaklara bakmalarını anlamaya çalışmaktan vazgeçerek.
Ama sonra, o anda, bir sonraki kıyafeti getiren kız öğrencinin tanıdığı biri olduğunu fark etti.
“Ah…” şaşkınlıkla sesini yükseltti.
Kız, “Ah, hey, hey orada,” diye seslendi ona. “Bir dahaki sefere bunu sana uydurmamın bir sakıncası var mı?”
“Evet, sorun değil ama… yani bugün buradaydın, hm?”
“Ahhh,” diye yanıtladı kız, şaşkınlığını okuyarak. “Bir dakika öncesine kadar arka tarafta küçük bir iş yapıyordum.”
“Demek öyle… Bunun için özür dilerim, tamam mı? Bu kadar aniden izinsiz girdiğim için.”
“Hayır, hayır, hiç de değil. Ah, aslında daha önce Kuze-shi’nin kılık değiştirmesine de yardım ediyordum, biliyor musun? Makyajla bile pek bir kıza dönüşmedi ama…”
“Ohhh~, demek o sensin.”
“Ne kadar küstah olsa da, evet…” diye doğruladı, bir an için oldukça resmi bir tona geçerek. “Ah, Kujou-san, aslında ben de senin makyajını daha sonra yapmayı düşünüyordum. Olur mu?”
“Elbette. Peki… O zaman bunu sana bırakıyorum,” diye yanıtladı Alisa. “Ahhh…”
Daha sonra, kız öğrencinin ona alaycı bir gülümseme göndermeden önce birkaç kez gözlerini kırpıştırmasına izin vererek sustu.
“Şimdi düşünüyorum da, aslında kendimi hiç doğru dürüst tanıtmamışım, değil mi?” kız sordu.
“E-evet…”
“Vay be, ne büyük bir gaf, ne büyük bir gaf. Ne kadar kabayım, ne kadar kabayım” diye özür diledi, hafif şakacı bir ses tonuyla.
Kız öğrenci hafif bir kahkaha atarak sağ elini göğsünün üzerine koydu.
“Peki o zaman, en baştan… ben Miyabi Shikumagawa, aynı zamanda Yırtmaç-senpai olarak da bilinir. Seninle iyi geçinmek için sabırsızlanıyorum.”
en: “…Yeah, he’s not cute, isn’t he?”
Her impression didn’t change particularly much. At best, all she could really say was something along the lines of a “You tried your best, hm?”
“Ehhh~? Alya-chan, you’re so mean~,” Maria protested. “The effort he’s putting into trying to be cute’s part of what makes him cute, isn’t iiit~?”
“No, Masha, you feeling that way makes you in the minority.”
“I mean, yeah, even I know that, but y’know… it’s not like you had to come all the way here to see me…” Masachika remarked.
Seeing an utterly rare sight of him sulking like that, Alisa shot a faint, wry smile before shifting her gaze slightly away.
【Your bare face’s just more charming,】 she murmured from under her breath.
“Come again, Alya-chan?”
“Nothing!”

Having been almost caught by her sister, Alisa quickly turned her face away even more sharply in an attempt to cover up her actions. Immediately after, Masachika—who’d been completely expressionless up ’til this point—curled his lips into a mischievous grin.
“Huh!? What!? Alya, you’re saying you wanna try crossdressing too!?” he shouted, intentionally misunderstanding her words.
At his sudden outburst, all the handicraft club members, who’d been completely absorbed with Scarlet-chan, snapped their heads toward her in unison.
“Eek!”

Letting out a slight shriek at the slightly mortifying sight of every girl turning their heads at once toward her, their eyes completely wide open, Alisa instinctively stepped back. Spinning around, she shot a sharp glance at her grinning partner, before then turning toward the one person capable of physically controlling the situation at hand, Chisaki.
However…
“Crossdressing as a guy, huh…?”
“Eh, Touya…?” Chisaki called out in response to the president’s remark. “Um, are you, by any chance… interested in seeing me crossdress?”
“Hmm. I mean, I’d be lying if I said I wasn’t… No, honestly, I am interested.”
“Touya… Alright, should I maybe… give it a go?”

As it turns out, their oh-so reliable vice president and esteemed head of the disciplinary committee was too busy flirting with her boyfriend. And once she was on board, there was just no stopping this bunch at the handicrafts club.
“Okay then. Since we’ve got the chance, the rest of you too!” one member declared, immediately jumping at the opportunity.
“So, we’ve got the Kujou sisters, Kiryuuin-san, and Suou-san… Wait, huh? What about Kimishima-san and Tsukamoto-san?” another said, pointing out Ayano and Aoi’s disappearance.
“Oh, there’s Kimishima-san! Where’s Tsukamoto-san?”
“Eh, she ran away? When did that happen!?”

With Ayano swiftly roped in as well—having initially faded into the background by the wall—it was decided that the girls would be the ones to crossdress this time. All except Aoi, of course, who’d made a quick escape, having declared “Like hell I’m standin’ next to a lineup of beauties like this!”
“Whoooaaa, that figure’s as killer as ever… Truly the goddess of proportions…”
“Huh? Kujou-san… did your chest get a li’l bigger again?”
“It’s not just that, her hips look to have gotten bigger too…”
“And yet her waist’s the same… How?”
“’Cause she’s a god.”
“Oh I seeee~”
For who knows how many times now, Alisa found herself surrounded by members of the handicrafts club, bringing outfit after outfit to hold up against her.

Still, setting all that aside, the situation of being attended to by the both of them brought on a sensation deep within her stomach that could only be described as part anxiety and part fear…
“Ah…! Hngh!” Ayano gasped as she squirmed in reaction.
“How’s that? Starting to feel all good?”
“Y-yes.”
“Your polite speech’s back, Ayano.”
“Y-yeah…”
What was more, facing the pressure of not being able to use her normal polite speech only made that sensation build even more and more.
“Alright, next up’s her back,” Masachika chimed.
“’Kaaaay,” Yuki agreed. “Alrighty then, m’lady. Let’s get you on the bed, okaaaay~?”
With Yuki calling her “m’lady” once again, something inside of her finally snapped.
“Eee—”
“Eeeeeeeeeeeeeek!!!”
“Woooah!?”
“What’s wrong!?”
“Eeeeeeeeeeeeeek!!! Eeeeeeeeeeeeeek!!!”
““Did Ayano break!?”” the siblings yelled in unison.
Clutching her head as she let out bizarre cries, Ayano rolled around on the floor before curling up into a small ball face-down, breathing in ragged breaths.
“…Please ride me.”
Her gaze remained fixed on the floor as she practically squeezed these words out.
“Huh?”
“Come again?”
“I beg you… Please… ride me…!”
“R-ride you…?” Masachika murmured, bewildered.
“Eh? You mean like this?”
Complying with Ayano’s request, Yuki settled onto Ayano’s back, allowing her to timidly feel the pressure of her hips.
“Ahh…!”

That weight on her back. The pain in her arms and legs. Such sensations came together to wash away all the guilt and tension that had built up throughout her entire body, dissolving them with a soft, fizzing release.

At this moment, Yuki-sama is… nothing but a servant, so I… who has become her chair, am therefore even lower… Ayano thought, using such wild logic to cope with the present situation. It is like I’m furniture. No, maybe livestock? Heh… Heheh.
“Eh? What’s up with this girl laughing like that…? That’s scary,” Yuki remarked.
“Is she… kicking down her self-respect in order to stay mentally stable…?”

“Shouldn’t we be just calling it self-deprecation at this point…? Oh weeeeell, might as well just go ahead and fondle her ass since we’re here,” Yuki slyly said, taking full advantage of the situation at hand. “Ohhh~, ohhh~, now ain’t that quite a nice ass, huh?”
“Stop with the casual sexual harassment already,” Masachika grumbled, whacking his sister right in the head.
“Ow… Anyway, banning her in everyday clothes and the whole ‘no polite speech’ thing looks to be the right choice for now, right? For her mental stability, I mean.”
“You’re the one who had the bright idea to change how she spoke in the first place…”
It was now after that exchange.
With Masachika and Yuki having changed into their casual home clothes, Ayano had at long last finally returned to her usual state of mind.
The three of them now sat at the table facing one another, with Masachika having lowered his head with a serious expression.
“Well, um… we somehow kinda ended up fooling about, so… sorry, okay?” he apologized. “For putting you through all that stress.”
“Eh…? N-no, that isn’t—”
“No, hear me out.”
Reacting to his solemn tone, and realizing that he was now talking about more than just what had gone down earlier, Ayano swallowed the words that had instinctively risen to her lips.

“I had given you a painful role to play, and ended up doing something that betrayed your devotion on top of it. I’m truly, very sorry,” Masachika admitted, apologizing with another deep bow before relaxing his expression slightly as he continued. “And also, I’m… honestly grateful that you worried so much about me to the point where you had even hurt your heart for my sake. Thank you.”

Hearing his sincere words, his honest appreciation for all that she had done behind the scenes, Ayano felt a gentle warmth spreading from deep within her chest. Her eyes unexpectedly grew hot out of nowhere, and she clenched her hands tightly beneath the table, blinking over and over as she steadied her throat.

“…Such praise is far too kind for me,” she said, taking a deep breath to suppress the swell of such immense emotion before offering her own words in order to keep her master from worrying. “And… I do not consider what you did as an act of betrayal. Certainly, I had been surprised at the time, but… I understand that it was something unavoidable as opposing candidates.”
“…Gotcha.”
With Masachika nodding in visible relief, Ayano let out a quiet breath of her own, the tension releasing from her shoulders.

“And let me thank you too, okay?” Yuki chimed in, shifting the focus to her. “You really saved us this time, Ayano… Had you not been there, Nonoa-san might’ve completely crashed the election for me and Onii-chan… We might’ve really lost the very stage to clash our conflicting motivations before we even got the chance… So, really, thank you. I’m truly happy that you’ve stayed as my partner, Ayano.”

The moment Ayano heard those words, the dam that she had been barely holding back inside finally burst all at once. Her vision was swallowed by tears, and droplets soon began to stream down her cheeks one after another.
“Th-thank you… very much… *hic*!”
Squeezing out only those words from her trembling chest, Ayano lowered her head and let her tears fall.
With the sharp scraping sounds of chairs being pulled back from right in front of her, she then felt the warmth of her beloved masters against her back and her head.
Ah…
In truth, Ayano had been anxious all along.
Though despite thinking that Nonoa was plotting something when she had faced her on that very emergency stairwell, she had still, in that moment, instinctively leapt straight into her grasp.
What was Nonoa trying to do? Would it harm her two masters? She had no certainty about it all.
Could my very actions themselves be a betrayal against my masters?
Would they be disappointed in me if I confessed that I was deceiving someone like this?
It had been doubts like these that had swirled endlessly in her mind up until this point.

But now… all of that anxiety had finally been swept away. Such a relief, combined with the reassurance that she had truly been of help to the both of them, now caused all that pent-up anxiety and fear she had been shouldering to spill out as tears.
“Thank… goodness… Oh thank goodness…” Ayano uttered, continuing to sob quietly as she felt Yuki’s arms as they gently embraced her and Masachika’s hand as it softly stroked her back.
A peaceful silence then passed for a while… As the last of her tears finally stopped and she began to calm down, an intense wave of embarrassment then suddenly washed over her entire body.
“U-um… um…”

Murmuring in a voice as faint as a mosquito’s buzz, Ayano lightly shifted her body, with her two masters letting go and returning to their own seats across from her, understanding her intent. Feeling a small trace of loneliness at that, Ayano then stood up with the scrape of her chair.
“U-um, please excuse me… I will go wash my face…!” she said, bowing hurriedly as she did before immediately dashing to the bathroom.
Taking the opportunity to fix her hair as well, she returned to the living room after gathering her composure.
“Thank you… for waiting…”
Still unable to look at the two of them out of lingering shame, Ayano returned to her seat.
“So, Ayano… What d’you wanna do?” Yuki asked gently.

“Well, I’ve been doing some self reflecting after everything that’s happened this time around, y’know…?” she confessed. “I heard you apparently told Nonoa-san that all you want is for me and Onii-chan to get along, and that got me thinking that maybe those really were your true feelings, or something… Or that you possibly didn’t want to go up against Onii-chan in the elections too, I guess~? Things like that… The more I thought about it, the more I’ve realized that I’ve never actually properly asked what you want, Ayano.”
Pausing to scratch her head, Yuki then gave a wry smile.
“So, I’ll ask you again, okay?” she asked again once more. “Ayano, what do you want to do? What do you want us to do?”
Looking over, Ayano saw that Masachika was waiting for her answer as well, wearing a gentle expression just like Yuki’s.
As for myself… she thought, almost confessing the desire hidden within the depths of her heart… only to swallow it at the very last moment.
A wish so stained with such a selfish desire that it was something, as a servant, must never be said.
So… instead, Ayano voiced a different wish.
“I… would like to play cards.”
“…Cards?”
“Yes, like in the old days… I would like to play cards together. The three of us.”
Turning to each other at her answer, Yuki and Masachika both gave slightly awkward smiles.
I understand that, Ayano thought.
She knew that this was not the answer her masters had truly wanted her to give.

“…Alright, as I requested, let’s play cards now, shall weee~?” she said, intentionally speaking in an out-of-character tone with that in mind. “We decided today’s a day we do everything ol’ Ayano wants to do, riiight~?
“That’s right, huh?” Masachika agreed. “Now, where were these cards again…?”
Despite her two masters most likely—no… without a shadow of a doubt—noticing that she had dodged the question, they still chose to go along with it as if nothing had happened.
I’m sorry… And thank you very much, she apologized in her heart to those endlessly kind masters.
“Ah, found them,” Masachika called out from his room. “These are the ones I used for practicing magic and like tricks, though…”
“Oh, well let’s use those then, yeah? There aren’t any trick cards mixed in them, right?” Yuki asked.
“There aren’t, there aren’t. Uhhh, we’ve got the three of us… so is poker fine?”
“Yes, that’s not a problem,” said Ayano.
“Alrighty, we’ll need chips, hm…? Oh well, I guess chocolate’s fine, huh?”
And so, with ten pieces of chocolate handed out to each of them as chips, Masachika began to shuffle the cards.
“So the rules are… we take turns being the dealer, and have five cards per hand. You get one draw before we start betting. Sound good?”
“Yes.”

“Hol’ on a sec,” Yuki interrupted, raising her hand with a quick flick of her wrist as she looked at both Masachika and Ayano. “Playing normally means that Ayano would be at a huge advantage from being worse at mind games than us, wouldn’t she? Shouldn’t we add one more rule here?”
“Well I guess that’s fine… What exactly?”
“Fufuuu~, I’ve actually found this interesting app the other day, ya knooow~?”
With a delighted expression that practically screamed, “So glad you asked,” Yuki fiddled with her phone before turning its screen to the other two.
“A lie detector app!” she exclaimed. “We’ll play mind games while using this!”
“…Would that even make it a mind game at that point?”
“Yeah, yeah, just try installing the app first, okay? Both of you,” Yuki said, nonchalantly dismissing Masachika’s valid point.

Following her suggestion, both Masachika and Ayano downloaded the app and got through its initial quick setup. The app itself apparently worked by placing your index finger on the screen while you spoke, with it judging whether your statement was a lie or the truth based on your pulse and voice. The more likely it was that you were lying, the more the needle swung to the right… That was how it basically worked.

“After each player finishes their draw and before we start betting, everyone gets to ask one question to anyone else, starting from the dealer and going clockwise…” Yuki explained. “Said person being asked must then answer while using the app. So? Think that sounds pretty interesting?”
“I… suppose so?” Ayano answered, despite still not grasping the special rules as she did.
No, or rather, she did understand the rules themselves.
But what sort of strategies would they lead to?
She couldn’t imagine how the game would unfold at all from it.
On the other hand, however, Masachika looked to have already read that far ahead, slowly nodding with a thoughtful expression.
“Sounds good. Let’s do it that way, yeah?”
“Okaaay. Then, we’ll do two rounds for now, six matches total, alriiight~?”
With that, the three of them placed their phones on the table, and the game began.
The first match.
After drawing and exchanging her dealt cards, Ayano ended up with pocket rockets, and as the special rule kicked in immediately, Masachika spoke to Yuki.
“Yuki, is your hand stronger than a two pair?”
“Yeah,” Yuki answered instantly with a gentle smile, the needle on her screen swinging up to around thirty on a scale of a hundred before falling back…
Uhhh…? Was that… a lie? Or the truth? Ayano thought, struggling to keep up with the ambiguous result, just as Yuki turned toward her.
“How ’bout your hand, Ayano? Is it stronger than a two pair?” she asked.
“Eh? Ah, um…” Ayano stumbled, her head spinning as she frantically raced through her thoughts.
At the very least, she understood that an honest “No” here was almost certainly a loss.
“Yes.”
Woosh! The needle on her screen shot to the right.
“No way, you really are that transparent, huh?” Yuki remarked.
“You’re way too easy to read, Ayano…” Masachika agreed. “Even though your face’s so expressionless.”
At the mixed expressions of exasperation and fond amusement from her two masters, Ayano slightly shrank her shoulders.
“Now then, it’s your turn, Ayano. Ask away.”
“Ah, yes…”
Egged on by Yuki, she then attempted to sort out the current situation to figure what to ask.

Uhhh, Yuki-sama’s hand is most likely a two pair or better… and since Masachika had asked whether it had been, does that mean he has a two pair too? she contemplated. Did Yuki-sama also take that the same way? Was that why she asked me the same question after concluding that she could beat him? Uh, uhhh…

And yet, what all trying to organize her thoughts did was make everything in her head become a tangled mess. On top of that, the pressure of making her two masters wait threw her thinking further into more confusion…
“Y-Yuki-sama, may I ask what your hand is!?” Ayano asked in the end, an absurdly straightforward question bursting right out of her mouth.
Widening her eyes slightly in response, Yuki then shot a small smile.
“A royal flush.”
The needle on her phone swung sharply to around ninety on a scale of a hundred.
“Ah…” Ayano muttered, realizing her mistake.
Why hadn’t she just asked the same kind of question as the other two? Wouldn’t asking something so specific, like she had, be brushed off so easily with an answer that was obviously a lie?
“That’s… Oh well, it’s still the first round. Don’t sweat it, Ayano,” Masachika offered these words in an attempt to cover for her.
Still, realizing that she had completely wasted her question, Ayano could only shrink her neck in embarrassment.
“Now then, we’ll move on to betting, alright?”
However, with Masachika’s next words snapping her right out of it, she quickly shifted her thoughts into reconsidering the intent behind the two of their questions.

As I thought, the most probable scenario is… Masachika having a two pair and Yuki-sama having a hand stronger than that, is it not? she thought to herself. If that obvious lie she had given just now was at around ninety percent, then her earlier answer to Masachika’s question was, in all likelihood, truthful.
Either way, with just pocket rockets, her chances of winning here were extremely low.
“Okay, I’ll go first…” said Masachika. “Bet.”
“Raise,” Yuki declared almost immediately, sliding forward two more chocolates than he had.
Seeing that, Ayano turned her conjecture into certainty, placing her hand face-down on the table.
“I will fold.”
“Call,” yet Masachika proclaimed the instant after.
His unexpected announcement made her eyes widen slightly.
Masachika-sama is accepting her challenge…!? It can’t be, could his earlier question have been a trap, and that his hand is actually stronger than a two pair? Or maybe so?
While Ayano remained in a daze, the other two revealed their hands…
Masachika, a pair of Jacks.
Yuki, an utter fish.

With the game unfolding in a way that completely defied her expectations, Ayano blinked repeatedly in confusion. And yet, on the other hand—and for some reason—the two siblings exchanged bold, all-knowing smiles.
“Look at you… Fooled the lie detector right off the bat, haven’t ya?” Masachika taunted.
“Heh, this level of skill’s just basic for an otaku, ya know?” Yuki shot back. “Then there’s you, Onii-chan, tryna bait me with that very first question, didn’tcha?”
The both had jumped straight into fighting a battle of the wits on a level that Ayano could never even hope to reach.
From then on, the two of them skillfully fooled the lie detector again and again, with Ayano—who reacted transparently each time—standing no chance of competing.

Aside from one lucky win when she managed to get a full house, she spent the rest of the rounds doing nothing but endlessly coughing up her chocolates, until at last they reached the question phase of the sixth and final match.
“Hmm~, let’s seeee. Alrighty, Ayano,” Yuki said, turning to Ayano when it came to her turn, with she and Masachika having already finished with their own questions.
With their gazes meeting after having been called on, Yuki gave her a gentle smile.
“Let me ask that same question again, just one more time… Ayano, what do you want to do?”
And with those unexpected words, Ayano’s thoughts came to a halt.
“What do you want us to do, Ayano?”
A question from her master, filled with nothing but absolute care.
Letting out a small gasp in reaction, Ayano sat in front of the two of them as they waited for her answer with gentle gazes.
There’s nothing else I want from the two of you, she almost said on instinct… only for the lie detector in her hand to catch her attention.
But… I absolutely mustn’t say it.

That was her pride as a servant; she simply couldn’t make any presumptuous wishes to her masters. For someone in her position, giving instructions to her masters was something she had absolutely had no right to.
I absolutely mustn’t…
But lying here wasn’t allowed.
And to dodge the question again, after they had asked her once more…
I absolutely…
Having turned that determination over in her mind twice, and then a third time…
“I… would like…” Ayano began to speak, her lips moving on their own before she knew it, weaving her words together amidst a countless number of thoughts that tangled together in her mind.
“I would like… for the three of us to stay together forever.”
And once those words were spoken, more began to pour out one after another.
“Like this. Forever… I want the three of us to stay close and be together. Forever, and ever…!”
Clenching her hand tightly over her phone, she lowered her face deeply and pressed her lips together.
I said it; I messed up…!
But as a burning shame rose within her, followed by a creeping sense of regret… a hand gently rested on her downturned head.
“Thank you,” came Masachika’s gentle voice. “I’m glad you said that.”
Ayano slowly lifted her face.
And there, she met the gazes of the two siblings, the look in their eyes as caring as always… no, even more caring than they had been just moments ago.

“Mm, thanks for being honest. I understand your feelings now,” Yuki chimed in, gently wrapping both of her hands around Ayano’s own—still clenched on top of her phone—before looking straight into her eyes. “I promise, okay? Onii-chan and I will always stay close, and you’ll always be with us too, Ayano.”

“Yeah… We’re childhood friends, no matter what happens from here on out…” Masachika said softly, only to hesitate slightly before then giving a soft, gentle smile. “No, I’ve… always thought of you as a little sister too, Ayano. We’re siblings… so we’ll always be close, and we’ll always be together.”
Their words made an immense warmth blossom from deep within her chest. Closing her eyes, Ayano basked in that sensation for a moment… before opening them once again and giving her own small smile.
“Yes.”
“Mm.”
“Yeah.”

tr: Üçü daha sonra birbirlerinin bakışlarıyla karşılaştılar ve birkaç saniye boyunca gülümsemelerini paylaştılar… ancak Yuki aniden geri çekilip ortamı yeniden ayarlamak istermiş gibi sesini yükseltti.
“Pekala! Şimdi son hesaplaşma! Sonuna kadar saçma sapan bahisler oynamanın hiçbir anlamı yok! Haydi gidelim! Her şey dahil!” dedi ve tüm çikolatasını dramatik bir takırtıyla öne doğru itti.
“Hey, hey, aslında hepsine bahse mi girdin? Şu ana kadarki tüm maçların ne anlamı vardı…” diye karşılık verdi Masachika, tüm çikolatalarını da ileri doğru iterken alaycı bir gülümsemeyle.
Buna karşılık Ayano da sayıları diğer ikisine göre çok daha az olan çikolatalarını önüne itti ve tüm bahisler sonuçlandı.
“Pekala o zaman… ellerini göster! Hesaplaşma!”
Yuki’nin çağrısı üzerine üçü kartlarını teslim etti…
“Ne—!? Düz bir floş!?” diye bağırdı dramatik biçimde başını tutarak.
“Hey, hey, cidden mi?” Masachika alaycı bir kahkaha atarak ekledi.
Bu arada Ayano utançla omuzlarını küçülttü. Yuki hemen geniş bir sırıtışla masadaki tüm çikolataları tek hamlede ona doğru savurdu ve alkışlamaya başladı.
“Tebrikler Ayano. Bugünün yıldızından beklendiği gibi.”
“Tebrikler.”
“Çok teşekkür ederim…”
İkisinin de alkışlarını alan Ayano utanarak gülümsedi ve omuzlarını daha da küçülttü.

“Şimdi öyleyse,” dedi Masachika, ortamı yeniden canlandırmak istermiş gibi ellerini bir kez birbirine çırparak. “Bundan sonra ne yapacağız? Başka bir oyun oynamak ister misin? Buna kazananın ayrıcalığı diyebilirsin: Ne istersen onu seçebilirsin, biliyorsun değil mi?”
“Uhhh, bakalım, hm…?” Ayano mırıldandı. “Peki, Hayat Oyunu’na ne dersiniz?”
“Hayat Oyunu, ha~? Sende var mı Yuki?”
“Ahh, bundan pek emin değilim. Ah, eğer konu o noktaya gelirse muhtemelen bir yerlerde bir video oyununun versiyonu vardır.”
İkisi konuşurken Yuki’nin odasına doğru giderken Ayano da sandalyesinden kalktı.
Ve yine de…
“Ah, iyisin Ayano,” diye seslendi Masachika ona. “Onu arayacağız.”
“Mm-hmm, mm-hmm,” diye onayladı Yuki. “Ah, aslında özür dilerim ama kartları kaldırabilir misin?”
“Ah… Kesinlikle.”
Söyledikleri üzerine bir kez daha sandalyesine yaslanan Ayano, bakışlarını yalan makinesi uygulamasının hâlâ çalıştığı telefonuna kaydırdı.
O anda…
“O günlere geri dönmek istiyorsun. Sadece üçünüzün olduğu o günlere: bu duygularla baş başa huzurlu ve mutlu zamanlar. Davetsiz birinin içeri dalmasını asla istemezdin.”
Nonoa’nın bir zamanlar söylediği sözler zihninde yeniden canlandı. Koridora açılan kapıya doğru dikkatli bir bakış atan Ayano, ardından işaret parmağını telefonunun üzerine koydu.
“Üçümüz iyi anlaştığımız sürece iyi olacağım,” diye mırıldandı. “Her ne kadar… artık ikisi için de en önemli ikinci kişi olmasam bile…”
Sözlerini bitirdikten sonra sessizce ekrandaki iğneye baktı.
“Hmm~? Bir şey mi dedin Ayanooo~?” Yuki ona seslendi.
“Hayır, önemli bir şey değildi.”
Aramasına cevap veren Ayano, ardından sessizce telefonunu kapattı.
en: The three of them then met each other’s gaze, sharing their smiles for several seconds… only for Yuki to suddenly pull back and raise her voice as if to reset the mood.
“Alright! Now’s the final showdown! There ain’t no point in making wishy washy li’l bets to the end! Let’s go! All in!” she declared, shoving all her chocolate forward with a dramatic clatter.
“Hey, hey, you’re actually betting it all? What was the point in all of the matches ’til now…” Masachika retorted, giving a wry smile as he pushed all his chocolates forward as well.
In response, Ayano, too, pushed forward her chocolates—far fewer in number than the other two—in front of her, and all bets were set.
“Alright then… reveal your hands! Showdown!”
At Yuki’s call, the three of them then turned over their cards…
“Wha—!? A straight flush!?” she exclaimed, dramatically clutching her head.
“Hey, hey, seriously?” Masachika added, letting out a wry laugh.
All the while, Ayano shrank her shoulders in embarrassment. Yuki, immediately breaking into a wide grin, then swept all the chocolates on the table toward her with one fell swoop and began to clap.
“Congrats, Ayano. As expected of today’s star.”
“Congrats.”
“Thank you… very much…”
Receiving both their applause, Ayano smiled shyly and shrunk her shoulders even more.

“Now then,” Masachika said, clapping his hands together once as if to reset the mood. “What do we do next? Wanna play another game? Call it winner’s privilege: you can choose whatever you like, y’know?”
“Uhhh, let’s see, hm…?” Ayano murmured. “Then, how about The Game of Life, perhaps?”
“The Game of Life, huuuh~? Do you have it, Yuki?”
“Ahh, not sure ’bout that. Oh well, I’ve probably got some video game version somewhere if it comes to it.”
With the two of them heading toward Yuki’s room as they talked, Ayano, too, rose from her chair.
And yet…
“Ah, you’re good, Ayano,” Masachika called out to her. “We’ll look for it.”
“Mm-hmm, mm-hmm,” Yuki agreed. “Ah, actually, sorry, but could you put the cards away?”
“Ah… Certainly.”
Settling back into her chair at their words once again… Ayano let her gaze drift down to her phone, where the lie detector app was still running.
In that instant…
“You wanna go back to those days. Those days when it was just the three of you: a peaceful and happy time alone with those feelings. You never wanted some intruder barging in.”
The words that Nonoa had once said resurfaced in her mind. Talking a careful glance toward the door leading to the hallway, Ayano then placed her index finger against her phone.
“I will be fine as long as the three of us get along,” she murmured. “Even if… I am no longer the second most important to each of them…”
Finishing with her words, she then stared silently at the needle on the screen.
“Hmm~? You say somethin’, Ayanooo~?” Yuki called out to her.
“No, it was nothing of any importance.”
Answering her call, Ayano then quietly switched her phone off.

tr: “Ah, Masachika-kun,” diye seslendi Yuki. “Bir dakikalığına şuna bakabilir misin?”
“Hımm~?”
“İşte bu kısım…”
Öğrenci konseyi şu anda toplanmış, olağan görevleriyle meşguldü.

Masachika ve Yuki’nin her şeyin ortasındayken, erkek ve kız kardeş olduklarını açıkladıktan sonra bile her zamanki ileri geri hareketlerini sürdürdüğünü gören Touya, sadece biraz meraklı bir bakışla bakabildi.
“Hımm… Kardeşler, ha…?” diye mırıldandı.
“Hm? Sorun ne?” diye sordu Chisaki, Touya’yı başını eğmeye teşvik ederek.
“Hayır… Anlamıyorum, biliyor musun? Çünkü bana göre Suou açıkçası daha çok ablasına benziyor.”

“Bunun buralara kaymasına gerçekten izin vermiyorum Başkan. Yani cidden benim bu şeyin küçük kardeşi olduğumu mu söylüyorsun?” Masachika konuştu, başparmağını keskin biçimde Yuki’nin yüzüne doğrultarak galiba “Bu şaka çok sert dostum” dermiş gibi bir ifade oluşturdu.
“Bu doğru,” Chisaki onaylayarak başını salladı. “Yuki-chan daha olgun görünüyor, değil mi?”
Ancak Touya ile aynı fikirdeydi, onunla değil.
“Sarashina-senpai!?” Masachika itiraz ederken Alisa da başını salladı ve dudaklarında muzip bir gülümseme belirdi.
“Demek istediğim, okulda işlerin nasıl olduğuna bakılırsa… Yuki-san’ın ablan olduğunu söylemek yersiz olmaz, değil mi?” o tartıştı.
“Benimle dalga geçiyorsun, değil mi? Hadi.”
“Aman tanrım, aman tanrım,” diye bağırdı Yuki. “Peki o zaman Masachika-kun, bundan sonra bana ’Onee-chan’ demekten çekinmeyin, tamam mı?”
Masachika, “Olmaz, kesinlikle hayır,” diye açıkça reddetti.
