Without a word, the brother and sister duo stood up, circled around the table, and then tightly embraced Ayano from both her sides. Gently embraced by her two masters, Ayano could only shrink back bashfully, yet her cheeks loosened ever so slightly in a quiet happiness.
Alisa being hugged by her older sister, Masachika and Yuki hugging Ayano, and the couple on the sofa engaged in their sibling roleplay. Oh, and Elena, left completely behind.

“Wh-what even is this situation…?” Elena questioned, trembling at the utter chaos that had completely taken over the student council office. “U-uuuum, I’m… technically the oldest sister here though, you knooow~?” she then timidly called out, her tone of voice practically asking, “I wonder if you all even remember me?”
And yet, everyone was too absorbed in their own affection to notice her.
Then, suddenly looking like she remembered something, Elena turned toward Masachika.
“Oh right, Kuze-kun!” she exclaimed. “Our bet, our bet!”
“What…?” Masachika, who had been patting Ayano on the head, responded with a distracted voice before then looking down at the piece of paper still left sitting in front of his chair. “Oh.”

“Now then, time for payback for the Trick-or-Treat game, okay! Let’s wonder: how many of my rankings did you manage to guess, Kuze-kuuun~?” Elena snorted smugly, smiling with complete confidence in her victory as she looked at him.
Shooting her a detached glance in response, Masachika then reached over the table and picked up the piece of paper, unfolding it.
“Yeah, well, how should I put this, huh?” he mused, thrusting out its contents toward Elena.
“It was actually pretty easy to guess, I’d say.”
Written on the paper were… from bottom to top, eight names: Elena, Maria, Chisaki, Chisaki, Touya, Masachika, Alisa, Masachika.
“Wh-wha, wha…!?” Elena stammered in shock.
“This means I win, am I right?”
“Wh-what even is this!? You wrote two names twice, c’mon!”
“But that’s not against the rules, am I right? You never said it wasn’t allowed,” Masachika argued.
“Th-that’s… true, but…! There’s no cuteness in the way you tried to guess!”
“I wasn’t exactly looking for a cute way to win here.”
“Tha—… wha… Ggh…”

Leaving Elena, who so clearly wanted to say something but couldn’t quite get her words out, Masachika placed the piece of paper on the table for the Kujou sisters and Yuki, who were looking over at him with curious “What is it, what is it?” expressions.
“This is...”
“Woooow, impressiiive~,” Maria chimed in admiration. “You even got Elena-senpai being at the very tooop~”
“Yeah, I mean, I figured that she’d probably be the type to slyly include herself in the rankings, so…”
“By the way, what was your reasoning behind this order?”

“Hmm, well, excluding Elena-senpai, I figured that Masha-san would probably be at the top,” Masachika started. “Then, we have Prez and Sarashina-senpai feeling like the big sis-younger guy type of couple, so I put Sarashina-senpai above. Still, the tricky part was workin’ out where Yuki would go, y’know…? I figured she’d land somewhere between second and fourth, but decided it’d be fine as long as I get just one more placement right, so I intentionally left her out. And then, for the bottom three, I figured it’d most logically be me, Alya, then Ayano, but I also did think that since it’s Elena-senpai we’re talking about here, she’d probably have me at the very bottom… So, it makes sense to go along with the ‘it’ll be good enough as long as one of them is a hit’ mindset again here, right?”
“…That is impressive, hm?” Alisa nodded in admiration. “That’s pretty much mostly right, isn’t it?”
“You’re reeeally impressive, Kuze-kuuun~” Maria agreed, clapping with a bright smile.

It was only Yuki who noticed a small crease in the paper that fell exactly between Elena’s and Maria’s name, which would have allowed Masachika to make a mountain fold at where it was, effectively folding out Elena’s name and making his predictions appear as if there were only seven people starting from Maria…
Still, she deliberately chose not to point it out.
“Now then, Elena-senpai…” Masachika perked, turning back to Elena. “Safe to say it’s my win, am I right?”

“Ugh… ngh… g-gah…” she groaned bitterly in response, glaring at him for a few seconds before finally nodding wearily in resignation. “…Alright, okay? It can’t be helped if you’ve read all of it this well… I’ll admit defeat, ’kay?”
“Alright then, now go ahead and make your loser’s declaration, pleeease~”
“Ggh…!”
With a deeply frustrated expression, Elena dropped to her knees on the carpet…
“I stand corrected…! I spoke out of turn and sincerely apologize…!”

“That was fast,” Masachika quipped in surprise, seeing Elena bowing her head sharply, delivering her loser’s declaration at such a high speed, before lifting her head again all under barely three seconds.
“Aren’t you getting a little too used to grovelling like that…?” Alisa added, stumbling slightly in surprise alongside him.
However, as Elena stood up with an exaggerated “Phew,” wiping her forehead with her arm to feign the sense that she had actually accomplished something productive, Yuki spoke up from the side.
“Hold on a second, please,” she said. “Is that really all, Elena-senpai?”
“Eh?”
Blinking repeatedly as she turned around, Elena faced Yuki’s refined ladylike smile.

“You used an underhanded tactic and still lost, you know, Elena-senpai?” Yuki continued, pointing that out in a clear crystal clear tone. “In that case, as you had declared yourself, isn’t it only right that you take off your clothes?”
“Huh…? Eh? Eeeeh!?”

Taking a few moments to process her words, Elena then hurriedly crossed both her arms to cover her body in a panic. And yet, even as Masachika and Alisa shot their own stunned looks toward Yuki alongside her, all Yuki did herself was calmly maintain her archaic smile.

“Since Masachika-kun got six people correct, that should be your shoes, ribbon tie, blazer, skirt, and shirt…” she stated, counting them off on her fingers without a shred of mercy. “But that’s good for you, right? Looks like you’ve just barely kept your underwear on, hm?”
“Wha—? Eh…? N-no, but, still…” Elena stammered with a half-smile.
“You’re not actually serious, right?” her eyes silently pleaded.
And yet, Yuki just gently continued, as though she was patiently lecturing her.

“Listen to me, okay, Elena-senpai?” she spoke. “Please think about this calmly and objectively. What you did here was use tactics so underhanded that everyone was put off by them, all to try and force a junior two years below you to grovel and beg, isn’t that correct?”
With these words, Yuki then swiftly dropped her ladylike smile, before continuing in a completely dead-serious tone.
“To put it bluntly, that’s really messed up.”

“A look of a hundred percent pure contempt!?” Elena exclaimed, recoiling from her vengeful stare. “Uuuuuuu~,” she whined, clutching her head as she tried to escape her gaze while turning toward the junior who had so vehemently rejected the idea of a stripping game earlier with a plea for help. “…Ch-Chisaki-chan!”
However…
“H-hey, Touyaaa…” Chisaki coyed. “Have you ever wanted to try wrestling around or something?”
“Hmm? W-why?”
“Weeell… I’ve kinda heard that older sisters sometimes use pro-wrestling moves on their little brothers.”
“Th-that… certainly is something I’ve heard of before, maybe?”
“Right!? So, um… want to try it?”
“I mean, but… it’s pro-wrestling… That would mean, you know, our bodies would end up pressed against each other…”
“…Don’t wanna?”
“Oh, uh, n-no! Bring it on!”
“G-got it! Well then… here we go, okay? This one’s the… Argentine Backbreaker♡”
“Whoa, oof, gah… A-as expected of you, Chisaki…!”
“Hey noooow♡, it’s Onee-chan, ain’t it?”
“Chi-chisaki, Onee… gah!”
*Flirt, flirt, flirt, flirt…*

Watching the two of them as they formed their own special world that no one could possibly intrude upon, Elena swallowed her words right back down. Then, slowly turning her gaze away as if pretending she hadn’t seen any of it… she looked toward the Kujou sisters for help.
And yet…

Perhaps because Masachika was one who had been under the very serious risk of being forced to grovel, Alisa simply met Elena’s gaze with an icy look. Maria, too, tilted her head with a slightly troubled expression… before turning it toward Yuki.

“Um, you know what, Yuki-chan?” she spoke up. “It’s true that Elena-senpai’s cheating was pretty awful, and I do also think that it’s entirely all her own, but… I think making her end up in just her underwear feels a little too pitiful, don’t you think?”
The fact that even the kindhearted Maria couldn’t defend what she had done at all made the reality all the more serious.
“Ugh… Th-this sorta sympathy… stings in its own way…!” Elena groaned, clutching her chest as if she had taken a hit from the blow of being directly pitied by a junior of hers.

“It is, right?” Alisa agreed, following Maria’s reasoning. “Sure, she did ask for it herself, but still… being in nothing but her underwear in front of the opposite sex feels a bit too pitiful, I think.”
“Urgh…” Elena moaned in pain once more.
“That’s right,” Masachika spoke up next. “Besides, I have absolutely zero interest in seeing Elena-senpai in her underwear or anything like that.”
“Guhah!”
As Elena took yet another heavy blow, Yuki placed her index finger to her chin and hummed in thought.

“Well then, let’s see…” she mused. “What if we have Masachika-kun blindfolded and then get her to take her clothes off? What do you think about that? The embarrassment should be less if no members of the opposite sex are watching her, wouldn’t iiit~?
“Eh, but Touya’s still…”
“I don’t think Prez is in any state to notice that right now if we’re talking about him…”
Following Yuki’s gaze, the others looked on as the student council president and vice president couple continued their (life-threatening) happy wrestling.
“Oh, feel this one, okay? This is… the famous Cobra Twist,” the latter chimed in delight.
“Oof!? H-haha…! Amazing!” the former spoke in agony. “You sure know your stuff, huh, Chisaki-oneechan!?”
“Eeeeh? I don’t really know that much… Now, we’ll move onto the Octopus hold from here♡”
“Gagh! Th-that sure is bold, huh!?”

Entwined by his girlfriend (physically), Touya laughed happily as his eyes rolled backward. Seeing his face like that, Elena decided—yet again for the third time—to pretend as if she hadn’t seen a thing.
“Very well! I am a woman of my words!” she declared firmly with crossed arms. “I’ll take proper responsibility for what I said as your senior, okay!?”
“Ufufu, now that’s our former student council vice president for ya,” Yuki smiled in satisfaction. “Well then, Ayano. Please blindfold Masachika-kun.”
“Huuuh?” Masachika uttered, raising one eyebrow. “You’re actually seriously gonna strip…? Who even benefits from this…? Or rather, should I just step outside?”
“No! Stay right there, Kuze-kun!” a voice then shouted, coming from none other than Elena herself to stop him, just as he slightly lifted his lips to stand.
“What sorta pride is that…? Or rather, what kinda fetish is this…?” he grumbled.
“Masachi—no, Chika… -onii-chan,” Ayano then spoke hesitantly, fidgeting slightly as she did. “Um, your eyes...”
“O-oh.”

Though she was completely expressionless, the atmosphere she carried somehow exuded an endearingly timid air, making Masachika nod reflexively. Moving behind him, Ayano then lightly reached forward to cover both his eyes with her hands.
Th-this somehow feels like… those “Guess who~?” type of scenes you see in manga… Masachika contemplated as he felt the soft sensation of Ayano’s hands around his eyes.

The darkness shrouding his vision sent a strange blend of nervousness and excitement coursing through his body. Then, as if she had come full circle, seemingly resigning herself to the situation, Elena’s voice—sounding as though it had regained some of its composure—reached his ears.
“Well theeen~” she chimed. “I guess maybe ol’ Erona-senpai will show the greedy li’l Yuki-chan her naughty underwear♡”
“Naughty underwear, you say? I look forward to seeing how it is then.”
“O-oh… I see,” Elena stuttered, unexpecting Yuki’s straightforward reply. “Alrighty then… I’ll start, ’kay?♡”
A brief silence drifted by after those words.
And then, the faint rustling of clothes—something Masachika could distinctively hear, perhaps because his vision had been blocked—and nothing else.
…Wh-what’s with this fetish-like situation?

With only the sound of rustling fabric vibrating his eardrums in the darkness, a tingling sense of restlessness began to arise from deep within Masachika’s core. Feeling that vague and dangerous unease, and his reluctance to focus too much on his senior stripping right in front of him, he forcefully displaced his thoughts toward the age ranking of the student council that Elena had listed out earlier.

Hmm, now that I think about it… she really was able to grasp the mature sides to Masha-san and Yuki, and more or less somehow grasped the dynamic between mine and Alya’s relationship too, Masachika contemplated, chewing over it all. Her eye for people’s actually pretty solid, isn’t it…? It’s impressive, but I guess it’s what you’d expect from her, huh?

As he felt a small amount of respect for his senior, who, despite seemingly living by the moment and by instinct, was able to firmly grasp the essence of things, Elena’s voice reached him from beyond the darkness once again.
“Alrighty… I’m taking off my skirt now, okay?” she announced in a teasing tone, having finally reached the stage at which her underwear would be visible.
“Whoooo~!” Yuki cheered, giving a small round of applause.
Following a cheerful “Whooo~!” from Elena herself, accompanied by an “Oh myyy~” from Yuki, Masachika tensed slightly despite not being able to see a thing.
Elena had apparently now finally taken off her skirt.
Then, once again, a moment of silence.

…What’s with this weird silence? Or rather, there’s been a whole lotta pauses and clothes-rustling this whole time, right? Masachika wondered, with the answer coming from Yuki’s voice a few moments later.
“Um, Elena-senpai,” she called out.
“Hm?”
“You folding the clothes you take off extremely neatly every time since earlier… is honestly killing the whole mood.”
“Eh? But I can’t just leave them all over the place…” Elena rebutted.
“That serious side of hers is showing…” Alisa commented.
“Elena-senpai sure must’ve been raised well, riiight~?” Maria added.
“Wh-wha!? Ain’t this normal…!?”

Following the Kujou sisters’ comments, Masachika slumped slightly in his chair, realizing the truth behind all those moments of silence. Then, feeling a small jolt of surprise from Ayano through the hands covering his eyes, fully unexpecting him to sink down, he raised his hand slightly in apology.
Hm?

The grip that Ayano had in her hands had loosened and shifted slightly, likely because of the fact that he had just slumped down in his seat. Or maybe it was also because she had intentionally kept her touch gentle, careful not to press down too hard on his eyelids.
Wait, Ayano! I can see! I can see! Masachika screamed inwardly.
A small gap had now somehow opened between Ayano’s fingers, letting him see ahead.
And although it was too narrow to see anything below Elena’s waist, Masachika could still catch clear glimpses of her in her white shirt, sending him into a full state of panic.
Still, it wasn’t like he could raise his voice to warn Ayano in this situation either, so…
“Alright then, here I go…” then came Elena’s voice. “I’m finally taking off my shirt now, okay♡?”
“Been waiting for thiiis~” Yuki grinned.

Hesitating as the overly enthusiastic Elena reached for the buttons of her shirt, Masachika reflexively shut his eyes tight. With his heartbeat now pounding hard in his ears, he held his breath and erased his presence…
“Tadaaa~!”
“Whoooa… amazing. It really is lewd…” Yuki chimed in astonishment.
“E-eeeh? Do you usually wear underwear like that, Elena-senpai…?” Maria asked.
“Whoaaa, that’s incredibleee~” Alisa remarked, unable to help as she marveled in amazement as well.
“Fufuuu, this here’s the true power of a lewd Onee-san, y’know?” Elena proudly boasted, her voice along with the girls’ murmurs of admiration fully reaching Masachika’s ears.
Then, he heard the rustling of Alisa and Maria standing up, joining Yuki as they walked toward her.
“It’s true, you really are like a lewd Onee-san, aren’t you…?” Yuki agreed.
“Isn’t this, um… what you’d call victory underwear?” the former inquired.
“Wooow~, so cuuuute~,” the latter gushed. “Where’d you buy iiit~?”
“O-oh, you guys sure are looking really close, huh…?” Elena said in a stammer, shrinking back slightly from the curious reactions of her juniors.
“This is just a simple question, but… doesn’t this strap here get itchy?” Alisa asked, pointing with her finger.
“What goes on with this part…?” Yuki followed up with a question of her own.
“Wooow, looook~. It’s see-through heeere~” Maria pointed out enthusiastically.
…Strap? See-through? The heck kinda underwear is that…?
Their irresistibly suggestive words flew around the room, vigorously arousing Masachika’s curiosity.
Real lewd underwear: something that would naturally fascinate any healthy teenage boy. The thought alone made his self-control waver dangerously.
“Um, being stared at so much is sort of…” Elena uttered, trailing off bashfully. “Or rather, being the only one in underwear while everyone else is in their uniforms makes this pretty embarrassing…”
“Don’t say that, Elena-senpai. That’s all part of your punishment too,” Yuki reminded her.
“…Pweeh.”
That sounded like those pathetic kinds of noises you’d find in those free sound effects libraries, Masachika mentally jested in response to the small-animal-like sound that faintly reached his ears.
Just then, a devilish Yuki and an angelic Masha popped into his mind.

“You’re curious, aren’t ya? You should just take a peek, y’know?” the former baited him. “C’moooon~, no one’s gonna notice anyway. Besides, it was Elena-senpai who said she’d show it all to you if she lost herself, remember?”
“You mustn’t! You absolutely mustn’t!” the latter pleaded. “You understand this yourself, don’t you? That looking now will make you really regret it and feel all depressed after!”
“Better to regret doin’ it than regret not doin’ it!!!”
“Kyaa! Aaaaaaaaah!” the angel screamed, instantly blown into the void following a D1 college American football-esque tackle from the devil…

“Um, this… was actually a gift from a junior in the wind ensemble club that I couldn’t refuse…!” Elena attempted to explain in a panic, just as Masachika peered his eyes open. “So it’s why saying the price and… those kinds of things… is a bit… Or rather, can you please let me put my clothes back on now!?”

What a pathetic person I am… I’m sorry, Elena-senpai.

Ancak bir sonraki anda hemen her zamanki ifadesiz yüzüne geri döndü ve koltuğuna dönmeden önce hafifçe selam verdi.

Birkaç saniye ona yakından baktıktan sonra Alisa, her kulüp tarafından sunulan çeşitli mali belgeleri düzenleyerek görevine başlamadan önce vites değiştirecekmiş gibi hafifçe başını salladı. Bir düşününce… onlar kardeşler, değil mi? Masachika-kun ve Yuki-san yani, diye düşündü kendi kendine.

Bu onun elinde olmadan tekrar fark ettiği bir şeydi, muhtemelen Yuki’nin Masachika’nın okuldaki çocukluk arkadaşı gibi davranması hiç de yabancı hissetmediği içindi. Buna ek olarak, Alisa onun küçük kız kardeşi gibi davrandığını yalnızca birkaç düzine dakikadır görmüştü. Bu iki faktör muhtemelen ilişkilerinin gerçek doğasının sık sık aklından kaçmasının ana nedenleriydi.
Şimdi geriye dönüp baktığında, Suou ailesinde tanık olduğu Yuki’nin geçici bir illüzyondan başka bir şey olmadığını hissediyordu.
“Alya-san? Bir sorun mu var galiba?” Yuki zarif ve kibar bir ses tonuyla sordu.
“Ah, hayır…”

Alisa’dan tam da bunu bir yanıt olarak aldıktan sonra hafif bir merakla başını hafifçe eğdi, zarif hanımefendi gülümsemesi bozulmadan kaldı. Bu kadar küçük bir jest bile belli bir zarafet taşıyordu. Bir tablodan fırlamış gibi görünen simsiyah renginin omuzlarının üzerinden rahatça akmasıyla birleştiğinde, yüzünü başka tarafa çevirdiğinde bu Alisa’nın tuhaf biçimde kendini bilinçli hissetmesine neden oldu.

“Hm? Ne kadar uzak…?”
“Açıkçası bunu kastediyorum, biliyor musun?”

Yumuşak sesini duyan Alisa şaşkınlıkla başını eğdi. Yine de Yuki, hiçbir şey olmamış gibi zarif hanımefendi gülümsemesini sürdürürken, ellerini zarifçe masanın üzerinde kavuşturdu.

en: It was currently after school. Stepping into the student council office after finishing her cleaning duties, Alisa blinked in surprise, finding only Yuki and Ayano there.
“Good work today, Alya-san,” Yuki spoke up first. “What brings you here?”
“Good work today too, Yuki-san… Where is everybody?”
“Sarashina-senpai is with the disciplinary committee. Prez was called by a teacher a little while ago, and Masha-senpai is accompanying him in Sarashina-senpai’s place.”
“Ah, is that so.”
“Masachika-kun is with the wind ensemble, is that right?” Yuki asked, turning the question back on her.
“Yes.”
“Well then, seems like it’ll just be the three of us for a while. Ayano, tea for Alya-san.”
“Certainly.”
“Thank you, Ayano-san.”
With Alisa taking her usual seat and setting down her bag, Ayano quickly brought her a cup of tea.
“Thank you, Ayano-san,” Alisa smiled.
“Not at all,” Ayano replied with brief words.
Her expressionless face brought a memory rushing back into Alisa’s mind: one from a few days ago, from when that very same face had dramatically crumbled.

“Come to think of it, Ayano-san…” Alisa started, drawing a slight tilt of Ayano’s head as she hesitantly broached the topic. “…Uhhh, well… this is a bit late, but… are you okay? About Nonoa-san, I mean…”
Seeming to understand what she meant, Ayano blinked slowly before lowering her head.
“About that… I apologize for showing you an extremely unpleasant side of myself.”
“Ah, no, I wouldn’t… go as far as to say it was unpleasant…”
“Thank you very much for your concern, but I am already fine now.”
“Really? That’s good to hear, but…”
Unable to say anything further, Alisa trailed off with a faint sense of frustration… only to widen her eyes in surprise as Ayano gave her a faint smile.
However, she immediately returned to her usual expressionless face in the next instant, giving a small bow before returning to her seat.

After staring at her closely for a few seconds, Alisa lightly shook her head as if to switch gears before beginning her duties by organizing various financial documents submitted by each club. Then, while glancing at Yuki—who sat across from her as she worked on what looked to be a public relations manuscript—she suddenly recalled the remark that Touya had given yesterday.
Come to think of it… they are siblings, aren’t they? Masachika-kun and Yuki-san, I mean, she thought to herself.

It was something that she couldn’t help but realize all over again, likely because Yuki acting like Masachika’s childhood friend at school didn’t feel out of place at all. To add to that, Alisa had only seen her acting like his little sister for a mere few dozen minutes. Those two factors were probably the main reasons as to why the true nature of their relationship frequently slipped from her mind.
Looking back now, it almost felt as though the Yuki she witnessed back at the Suou household had been nothing more than a fleeting illusion.
“Alya-san? Does something seem to be the matter?” Yuki asked in a gracious, polite tone.
“Ah, no…”

Receiving just that as a response from Alisa, she then tilted her head slightly in mild curiosity, her refined ladylike smile kept intact. Even a gesture that small carried a certain elegance. Paired with the way her jet-black flowed smoothly over her shoulders, resembling something out of a painting, it made Alisa feel oddly self-conscious as she turned her face away.
That’s right: Yuki-san at school is this Yuki-san, after all… she mused as if to remind herself. As for that Yuki-san… Yeah, let’s forget about her for now.
Having decided that in her mind, Alisa then lowered her gaze back toward the financial documents in her hands.
The two then focused on their respective duties for a while.
That was, until she heard Yuki call her name.
“Alya-san.”
“What?” Alisa asked as she looked back up.
“I apologize; may I have a moment?”
“Sure, I don’t mind.”

“This here is an explanation to the entire student body regarding last week’s student assembly…” Yuki spoke, showing her a manuscript. “I’d like you to check whether there are any issues with it, Alya-san.”
“Understood.”

Letting out a small gasp out of surprise, Alisa took a look. It regarded a matter that had deeply concerned her too, of course, one complicated by the fact that only certain details surrounding it could be made public while others absolutely could not. She read through it carefully.
…Mm, it looks fine for now. I’d still like to get Masachika-kun’s opinion on it later, though…
Her partner had the sharper eye when it came to seeing through hidden motives in writing or attempts at subtle manipulation, after all. It was something that Alisa acknowledged and relied on.
“I think it’s fine,” Alisa said as she finished reading Yuki’s manuscript. “You’ll have Masachika-kun and Prez check it later too, right?”
“Yes, that is indeed the plan,” Yuki assured.
“Then I don’t see any problems.”
“Thank you very much.”
“Oh, there is one typo though, you know?”
“Eh, are you sure?”
“Look, here…”
“Ahhh, you are right! Thank you very much, Alya-san.”
Smiling gently, Yuki corrected her manuscript as Alisa settled back into her chair.
“By the way, Alya-san. How far have you gone with Masachika-kun?” she then asked, casually throwing a question Alisa’s way, still maintaining her polite tone.
“Hm? How far…?”
“I obviously mean this, y’know?”

Putting on an elegant smile, Yuki formed a circle with her right hand and slid her left finger in and out of it in a slow, deliberate motion. And yet, even after witnessing such an unmistakably suggestive display, Alisa still hadn’t the foggiest idea as to what she was getting at.
She just somehow felt it was rather crude, and that was it.
“Uhhh… sorry. What’re you talking about?”
“Heeeey, Onii-chan,” Yuki called out to an imaginary Masachika in a murmur. “This one’s more super-duper clueless and smooth-brained than I thought, I’ll tell yaaa~”
“…Come again?”
Hearing her soft voice, Alisa tilted her head in confusion. Still, with Yuki simply maintaining her refined ladylike smile as if nothing had happened, she gracefully folded her hands atop the desk.
“No, I was just wondering whether there’s any possibility of you and Onii-sama becoming a couple, Alya-san.”

tr: “Ah, bunun arkasında daha derin bir anlam yok,” diye açıkladı Yuki. “Sadece öğrenci konseyi seçimlerindeki erkek-kadın çiftlerinin sıklıkla çıktıklarını duydum; Onii-sama ve ben de ortaokuldayken bu tür şüphelerle karşılaştık. Yani… sadece senin aranın nasıl olduğunu merak ediyordum, Alya-san.”
Sözleri Alisa’nın rahat bir nefes almasına izin verdi. Bir an için, duygularının anlaşılmasından korkarak kalbi boğazına fırladı.
“Ah, ahhh, demek istediğin buydu… Daha doğrusu… gerçekten böyle bir şey oldu, hım? Bu tür şüpheler yani.”
“Fufufu, durumumuz kesinlikle… oldukça sıkıntılı, değil mi? Çünkü biliyorsun, insanlara gerçek kardeş olduğumuzu dürüstçe söyleyemeyiz.”
“E-evet öyle, ha?” Alisa başını salladı ve kapıya doğru bakarken Yuki’nin okulda açıkça böyle bir şey söylemesinin sorun olup olmadığını merak etti.
“Sorun değil, biliyor musun?” Yuki ona bir gülümsemeyle söyledi, görünüşe göre niyetini anlamıştı. “Ayano kapının dışında nöbet tutuyor.”
“Ah, n-gerçekten…? Ne zamandan beri?”
Alisa kapının açılıp kapandığını bile duymamıştı ama görünüşe göre bir süredir yalnızdılar. Yuki onun bunu onaylamasını bekledikten sonra koltuğundan öne doğru eğildi.
“Başka bir deyişle, aşk hakkında istediğimiz kadar konuşmakta özgürüz, anlıyor musun?” ikna etti. “Peki, nasıl oldu?”
“Nasıl oldu…?”
Kendini toparlamak için kısa bir süre duraklayan Alisa sakince konuyu düşündü.
Elbette işler kendi içinde ilerlemişti. Bu tembel ama güvenilir ve gizemli komşuya karşı duyduğu hisler, bir zamanlar meraktan, sevgiye ve farkına bile varmadan aşka dönüşmüştü.
Ama şu anda Yuki’nin sorduğu konu kesinlikle ikisi arasındaki ilişkinin doğasıydı.
Yani, ilişkilerinin yalnızca gerçeklere dayanarak nasıl değiştiğini ve bunda ne olduğunu düşünürsek…
“Hiçbir şey… Gerçekten hiçbir şey yok, biliyor musun?” Alisa ona söyledi
“Aman tanrım, gerçekten öyle mi?”

“…Alya-san? Gözlerindeki ışık söndü, biliyor musun?”
“Bu değil…” diye mırıldandı Alisa, inkar etmeye çalışırken titrek bir sesle konuşmayı bıraktı.
Çünkü gerçekte hiçbir şey olmamıştı.

Elbette, ikisi birlikte pek çok şey yaşamış ve hatta daha önce birkaç kez randevuya benzer şeyler yapmış olsalar da… Masachika aslında ona karşı hiçbir zaman romantik bir ilgi göstermemişti. Alisa da kendi duygularını bile aktarmamıştı.

Günün sonunda, seçim kampanyasındaki ortaklar olarak bağları derinleşirken, kadın ve erkek olarak ikisi arasında herhangi bir ilerleme olup olmadığı sorulduğunda… hiçbir gelişme olmamıştı. Ha? Bir erkekle bir kadın arasındaki ilişki olabilir mi… içlerinden biri gerçekten duygularını itiraf edene kadar ilerlemez…? Alisa bunun farkına çok geç vardığını merak etti.
Artık çok açık duruyordu.

Her zaman bu şekilde olacağına inanmıştı ve aslında Alisa, Masachika’ya yakınlaşmış ve ona olan sevgisinin nasıl aşka dönüştüğüne tanık olmuştu. Ve yine de… sakince düşününce, eğer Masachika da aynısını yapmıyor olsaydı, o zaman ikisi arasındaki ilişki hiçbir zaman ilerleyemezdi.

Hayır ama bir saniye bekle? Diğer taraftan bakarsanız… aramızda hiçbir ilerleme olmaması ve Masachika-kun’un bana karşı hislerinin olup olmamasının tamamen alakasız… değil mi?
Evet, tam olarak buydu.
İkisi arasında herhangi bir ilerleme olmamasının nedeni, büyük bir itiraf olayını yaşamamış olmalarıydı. Tıpkı Alisa gibi Masachika’nın da ona karşı kendi duygularını beslemesi tamamen mümkündü.
Başka bir deyişle, zaten birbirimizden hoşlanıyor olmamız bile mümkün!?

İçinde geçit töreni başlamadan önceki konuşmayı hatırlayan Alisa, ışık gözlerine geri döndüğünde göğsünü şişirdi.

At the end of the day, while their bond as partners in the election campaign had deepened, if asked whether there had been any progress between the both of them as a man and a woman… there had been none at all. That was the only way to put it. Because after all, while Alisa had teased and even tried to tempt Masachika at times, she had never consciously once tried to close the distance with him as someone of the opposite sex.
Huh? Could it be a relationship between a man and a woman… doesn’t progress until one of them actually confesses their feelings…? Alisa wondered, her realization coming far too late.
It seemed so obvious now too.

H-huh? N-no… but, isn’t a confession supposed to be the final event in romance? Like, you’re supposed to go on a series of dates, nurture your feelings… and only then confess at the end of all of it, isn’t that how it is???

She had always believed that that was how it worked, and as a matter of fact, Alisa had grown closer to Masachika and witnessed how her affection for him had turned into love. And yet… when thinking about it calmly, if Masachika wasn’t doing the same, then the relationship between the both of them would simply never move forward.
So, that is to say… unless I confess after the election, nothing will change…? Alisa thought.
And just as that realization left her stunned, her thinking suddenly took a one-eighty like a bolt from the blue.

No, but wait a second? If you look at it the other way… the fact that there’s been no progress between us and whether or not Masachika-kun has feelings for me are completely unrelated… isn’t that right?
Yep, that was exactly it.

The reason there had been no progress between the both of them was simply because they hadn’t gone through the major event of a confession. It was entirely possible that Masachika, just like Alisa, had been nurturing his own feelings for her too.
In other words, it’s even possible that we already like each other!?
At this absurdly genius realization, the long-absent mini Alyas sprang into life, marching deep within her chest to a sharp rat-a-tat-tat of drums.
Maybe… Masachika-kun actually likes me too… but he’s just too shy to confess, or something like that…?

At that moment, the image of an embarrassed looking Masachika rushed into her mind, scratching his cheek as he averted his gaze away. The sheer convenience of such a pleasantly comfortable fantasy sent a shiver down her spine, and the mini Alyas inside of her erupted into a squeal of cheers.
【Geez… He’s so cute♡,】 Alisa blurted, letting her Russian words slip out along with a strange, amused giggle.
“Alya-san?” Yuki called out to her in a slightly taken-aback tone, sitting right across from her.
And yet, it didn’t reach her at all. Because Alisa was already in a field of flowers.

Is there a chance that… things’ll progress all at once the moment I confess? If anything, the fact we haven’t moved forward as a man and a woman just goes to show how seriously we’ve been focusing on the election without any impure distractions…
Arriving at such a conclusion, Alisa rapidly regained all her confidence.
Yeah, that’s exactly it! We’ll continue to deepen our bond as partners in the election, and after that’s all over, we’ll move forward as a man and a woman. This is totally the logical way to do it!
“Alya-saaan~?”
Called out once again by Yuki, who had leaned forward across the long table, Alisa snapped right back to her senses.
Huh? What were we talking about again…? she thought as the cogs in her brain started to turn once again. Ah, right, she was asking me about that: my relationship with Masachika-kun, hm?
Recalling the exchange from before the parade had begun inside of her, Alisa puffed out her chest as the light returned to her eyes.
“Yes, there’s nothing to it!” she proudly declared. “We are…” she continued, pausing briefly to add a soft, 【for now】, “simply partners in the election!”
“What’s with that sudden burst of confidence…?”
Looking at Alisa as she nodded over and over with a look of absolute certainty on her face, Yuki could only lean back slightly in her chair.
“Kyaaa! She said ‘for now’!” the mini Alyas squealed in uproar inside of Alisa’s chest. “She’s said it, she’s said it!!! She’s told his little sister! Kyaaaa!”
As they continued to flail about in a frenzy, Yuki straightened her posture.
“But you’ve still shown him your naked body, right?” she asked with a gentle smile.
“I haven’t, okay!?” Alisa immediately denied.

Caught completely off guard by Yuki’s casually dropped, baffling question, Alisa’s eyes went wide, looking as if she was about to scream “What are you even saying!?” at any moment. The mini Alyas that had paraded in her chest all froze at once, stunned into silence.
“Oh my?” Yuki meanwhile murmured with a puzzled look. “But you said he saw you while you were changing into your summer uniform the other day…”
“I was wearing underwear back then! He didn’t see me nake—ah!”
Having rushed through saying that much, Alisa stopped herself, realizing far too late that she had been skillfully led into confession, her expression turning sour.
“…You tricked me, didn’t you?”
“What could you possibly be talking about?”
“There’s no way he’d see me naked just from changing into my summer uniform! That’s obvious even to you, isn’t it!?”
“Oh well, I thought that you might’ve perhaps taken off your underwear to wipe your sweat off before changing…”
“Gah…”
Did I go too far there? Alisa instinctively thought, seeing Yuki lowering her brows slightly as she spoke with an almost apologetic meekness.
But still…
I won’t be fooled.

That’s right, this was something Alisa simply mustn’t forget. Although she looked like this now, Yuki’s true nature was that of a mischievous little troublemaker. No matter how much she put on that “But I didn’t mean to…” look, her actions were 100% intentional. She simply must not be deceived.
“That’s right, that’s riiight! Don’t fall for it!” the mini Alyas inside her chest shouted with pumped fists.

“Anyway,” Alisa said as if to clear the air. “I didn’t show him myself naked or anything like that… Or rather, it’s not like I actually ‘showed’ him myself in my underwear in the first place! He just ‘happened to see,’ you know!”
“Is clarifying that really that important?”
“It is! I’ve decided that the only man I’ll ever show my bare skin to is the one I’ll promise my future to!”

“How heavyyyy,” Yuki quipped with a straight face, before tilting her head again as her expression shifted toward one of puzzlement. “But he still saw you even if it was an accident, right? Is that really okay?”
“U-ugh…”
It was not okay. Not at all. But still… given that it was an accident, and given that the other person had been Masachika—her first love—it barely passed as acceptable.
Or rather, Alisa decided to treat it as sort of a “pending” matter for now.
That’s absolutely right, she reassured herself. We’ll just deepen our relationship from now on, become lovers, and someday…
Almost trailing off into yet another fantasy, Alisa shook herself out of it.
Anyway, when that happens, all it’ll just mean is that the order’s a little messed up. It still won’t go against my vow of having just one person for my entire life.
Still, given that was something she couldn’t exactly say out loud, Alisa resigned to giving a reluctant nod.
“I mean, but it was only for a moment, I guess?” she admitted. “I’ve honestly decided to just forget about it…”
“Oh my, is that really so?”
“…Or rather, you’re here acting as if this is all someone else’s problem, but… you were the one who hid my underwear during our summer retreat, weren’t you?”

Recalling all the crimes that Yuki had confessed to back at the Suou household, Alisa shot her a cold look. It was thanks to her that she had ended up being seen by Masachika in an utterly embarrassing state, one that was mortifying for reasons entirely different to just being in her underwear.

“Ah, that did happen, hm…?” Yuki remarked, keeping her ladylike composure, albeit smiling with a hint of apology. “I’m terribly sorry about that. I simply just couldn’t resist my mischievous intrusive thoughts.”
Is that even something you can brush off so lightly? Alisa begged the question to herself, her expression sharpening even more.
“Just so we’re clear, I’ll be seriously mad if you ever do something like that again, okay?” she warned. “Because the fact that I was seen by Ma—”
Because the fact that I was seen by Masachika-kun was the only reason why it was even remotely acceptable…
Stopping herself in her tracks, Alisa hurriedly swallowed the words she was just about to blurt out.
And yet, Yuki still caught onto the last bit.
“Because the fact you were seen by… who, you say?”
“…Nothing.”
“Shall I take a guess?” she chimed. “You were about to say that it was only remotely acceptable because Masachika-kun was the one who saw you, right?”
Gasping right on the spot, Alisa couldn’t help but flinch at how her thoughts had been read with almost psychic accuracy. Taking her reaction as confirmation, Yuki continued to press further.
“Just what d’you exactly mean by that?” she teased. “As I thought, Alya-san: you do feel something for Onii-sama—”

“Th-that’s not it…! It’s not about it being Masachika-kun or anything… it’s… right! The number of people! It’s a matter of how many! If the amount of men who’ve seen me in an embarrassing state is just one, then my chastity’s still safe… That’s all I meant!”
“So in other words, following your own beliefs, you’re essentially saying you intend to eventually marry Onii-sama.”
“I never did! You’re jumping the gun here! Or rather, it’s really starting to feel like you’ve been steering this conversation to that conclusion from the very start!”
“Oh my, is that so?”
“It is!” Alisa exclaimed.
Facing the front of her insistence, Yuki continued to play dumb, still tilting her head innocently.
“More importantly, what about you, Yuki-san…?” Alisa narrowed her eyes as she asked. “If it were up to you… um, would you want me and Masachika-kun to… g-get together?”
Wait, what do I do if she says no? she then pondered as the possibility flashed through her mind.
Because in any case, the person sitting right in front of her was the little sister of the person she loved, after all.

“Yuki’s not a love rival after all! Yaaaay~! Yaaaay~! Let’s celebraaate~!” Though she had once felt this way, when she chewed over the matter more carefully now, the little sister of the man she loved was, in some ways, even more troublesome than an actual romantic rival.
Especially after considering the fact that Masachika was—and putting it incredibly lightly—quite the siscon…

Because in the end, all it would take was for Yuki to say something even remotely hesitant like, “Alya-san becoming Onii-sama’s girlfriend…? That’s a bit…”, to erect a sheer cliff right in the path of Alisa’s romance.
If… Yuki-san, as a little sister protecting her dear onii-chan she loves so much, stood in my way…

Struck by such an ominous thought, *snap!*, cracks began to split open right beneath the feet of the mini Alyas in her chest, causing them to scatter in all directions, screaming as they panicked and ran for their lives.
But whether or not she was aware of the anxiety and fear that swirled inside of Alisa at the moment, Yuki simply gave a smile.
“Yes, I do, don’t I?” she casually answered. “I’d be happy for it to turn out that way if possible.”
“So, if you’re asking me, and if possible, I’d like for you and Onii-sama to become lovers, Alya-san,” she repeated herself with the same smile, all the while Alisa stared at her with wide eyes.
Then, having fully processed her words, Alisa let out a sharp gasp.
Approval from his little sister: obtained.
A giant champagne tower then emerged out of nowhere as light flooded her inner world. The mini Alyas, now in swimsuits, splashed gleefully atop of it.
Alisa herself almost felt like diving in and sliding down the cascading champagne like a water slide too.
However…
Hold it right there.
Slapping her own cheeks with an audible smack, she forcefully halted her widely racing thoughts. At the same time, she turned to the mini Alyas inside of her, calling for them to evacuate.
Right, don’t let your guards down, she announced. We’re dealing with that Yuki-san here; we can’t rule out the possibility of her setting me up for a fall.
Learning from her past experiences, Alisa then took a deep breath to steady herself.
“Why… is that?”
Her outright straightforward question elicited a soft, mature smile from Yuki: the same expression she had shown to her before at the Suou household… It made Alisa catch her breath instinctively.

“Onii-sama, can’t really go on without someone… someone whom he can think ‘I want to do my best for this person’ for…” Yuki spoke with eyes that seemed to gaze somewhere far away. “For Onii-sama, life is not something he lives for himself, but for the sake of someone else… Though he’ll… probably just brush it off with a self-deprecating ‘I just don’t have a sense of self’ if I put it like this, hm?”

It was something that Alisa could easily picture as well, finding herself struggling to find the right words as she faced Yuki’s small, troubled smile. With Yuki not pressing her for a response either, she instead folded her hands gently across her chest and continued.

“But in spite of all of that… I really love that part of him: the way he can put his full effort into something when it’s for someone else. And that’s exactly why… it was just so painful to see him lose sight of his goals after he left the Suou family.”

Her voice was awfully quiet, yet painfully earnest, a tone that caused Alisa to feel her own chest tighten as well. Lowering her gaze without realizing it at all, she clenched at her hands tightly… only for Yuki to gently rest her own over them from across the table.

“But that’s exactly why… I was happy,” she spoke softly, meeting Alisa’s startled gaze as she looked up at her. “That Onii-sama had started to walk forward once again, after gaining the goal of facing the election together with you, Alya-san. It’s why… I really am truly grateful to you.”
“Ah…”
“So thank you very much, Alya-san. For helping Onii-sama move forward. And if possible, I hope you’ll keep walking beside him from here on as well… and become his guiding light.”
Maybe it’s okay to tell her now? Alisa thought, the idea suddenly surfacing in her mind as she received all of Yuki’s sincere emotions.
Because wouldn’t it be okay? Surely the Yuki in front of her now would accept it all without teasing her, dare I say even support her, if she were to confess her feelings for Masachika.
As if partially driven by her instincts, Alisa began to open her mouth…
Only for Yuki to suddenly pull her hands away at that moment, raising both of them up.
“Just kidding, ya knooow~?” she chimed.
“My apologies, I didn’t mean to put any kind of strange pressure on you. Because if I’m being honest, I don’t really mind who ends up becoming Onii-sama’s girlfriend, you know?”
“Ehhhh…?”
Feeling as though the rug had been pulled from under her, Alisa gave a stunned look, drawing out a small chuckle from Yuki.
“It really doesn’t matter who it is, you know?” she said with a shrug. “As long as it’s someone who’ll make Onii-sama smile from the bottom of his heart… anyone’s fine.”
“Yuki-san…”
“But oh well, on the flip side, I’ll kill her if she’s some trashy woman who’ll make him unhappy.”
“Haha…” Alisa laughed awkwardly with a smile devoid of any negativity.
Though Yuki had spoken in a joking manner, there was no doubt that she was serious.
Because it must simply be her true feelings.
All Yuki simply wanted was for her beloved brother to be happy. It was a feeling as common as it was genuine, and one she clung onto with all her heart.
“Got it… Fufu, I understand now.”
“Well, whoever it is will eventually be my sister-in-law too, right?” Yuki remarked in response to Alisa’s chuckle. “So I’d be happy if she’s someone who’ll get along with me too, you know?”
“Ah, yeah… Well that’s only natural, isn’t that right?” Alisa agreed, nodding with a composed expression on the surface as if to hum an “Mm-hmm.”
In other words, someone like me, right!? yet she smugly grinned inside.
“Oh, that’s right. I’d prefer it if she’s beautiful if possible.”
In other words, someone like me, right!? Alisa asked herself once again, albeit with way more conviction this time.
“Oh, I’d also be even happier if boobs were huge.”
In other words, someone like me… hm?
“Preferably with a huge butt and nice plump thighs too. And a personality that’s fun to tease, I’ll tell you!”
That’s… in other words… me, right!?
“And that’s why you’re his ideal match for me, Alya-san!”
“I’m not sure how I’m s’posed to feel about that!?” Alisa exclaimed, raising her voice in a confused protest as such shameless desires were thrown her way head-on.

“Ufufu,” Yuki softly chuckled in response, before then suddenly looking upward as if struck by a thought. “Ah, but if we’re going down that route… then Masha-senpai might be ideal too, hm? She’d probably get all affectionate and would always be asking for skinship if it’s her we’re talking about.”
“Eh?”
“Ufufu, being Masha-senpai’s li’l sister-in-law, taking baths together and having pillow talks with her… I’d really love to try that!”

Alisa could only sit in silence as her own older sister—someone who had looked to get closer to Masachika as of late—was suddenly put forward as a candidate. Her presence as an unexpected ambush… and the mental image of her getting along with a younger sister-in-law in place of Alisa now overlapped with the scene from yesterday: Maria being all happy from being called “Onee-chan” by both Ayano and Yuki. All of it sent a sense of unease stirring right in Alisa’s chest.
“It’s not like… I don’t like skinship or anything though…” Alisa said, trying to brush it off as she flipped her hair back.
“Oh my? Is that really so? You usually seem all reluctant when Masha-senpai clings to you…”
“That’s just… um… because she won’t stop if I spoil her… It’s not like I mind it… As long as it’s within reasonable bounds, then even I…”
“Hmm~?” Yuki purred in a slightly skeptical tone, watching Alisa as she began to trail off.

“Wait, it’s not like that means anything, okay?” Alisa asserted in response, snapping back to her senses as she narrowed her gaze toward Yuki. “I’m just saying I don’t go out of my way to avoid skinship itself… That’s all!”
“Hm… is that really so? Okay then, is something like a greeting hug fine?”
“A hug? I mean, we do that at home too, so I think it would be…”
Like, those are basically hugs, right? she thought, recalling the cheek kisses she does with her family.
That is, placing your hand against another person’s shoulder while lightly touching cheeks.
Still, unbeknownst to her, the “hug” that Yuki was referring to went far beyond what Alisa was imagining.
“Are you really sure it’s fine?” Yuki asked. “Because our hugs don’t just use arms, we use legs too.”
“Eh? Legs?”
“Yes, we hug each other with not just our arms, but our legs as well.”
A line dropped so casually, as if it were the most obvious thing in the world. It left Alisa confused as she tried to picture it.
Hugging each other with their arms… and their legs too?
What came to her mind was an utterly ungraceful sight: an almost comical image of someone clinging to another person with their legs wide open.
“Ngh,” Alisa grimaced, letting a strange voice out from the back of her throat as she shot Yuki a reproachful look, deciding that she was being teased. “There’s no way a greeting like that exists.”
“Ehhh? We really do that sorta thing though…” Yuki refuted while sitting with her head tilted in confusion.
“Listen here…” Alisa grumbled, raising her voice tinged with a hint of irritation.
But just then… the door to the student council office swung open, and in came Masachika.
“Good work guuuys,” he sang as casually waltzed into the room.
And in the blink of an eye, Yuki set off dashing.
“To be precise: like this!!!” she shouted boldly, ripping off her refined ladylike façade as she rushed up to her brother.
Springing off the ground with a boing, she wrapped both her arms and legs around him, latching onto him completely.
“And then like this!!!”
Booming once again, this time in a deep, rough voice, Yuki rubbed her cheek against him over and over, fawning over him with a “Yaaaay~♪, Onii-chan’s heeere~♡,” immediately switching to a sweet tone.
And then finally, she unleashed her finishing touch.
“What’s more: this!!!”
Declaring that once more, Yuki grabbed Masachika by the shoulders to lift her own body up before locking her legs right around his chest, squeezing his head tightly against her.
“Welcome baaaack~♪, Onii-chaaaan~♡”
Still speaking in that extremely sugary voice, she rubbed her cheek against the top of his head in a series of quick, circular motions, before then glancing back over his shoulder at Alisa.
“Alright, wanna give it a go?” she asked, giving her a confident thumbs up.

“There’s no way I’d wanna, would I!?” Alisa snapped back instinctively, all the while Masachika—who had barely even stepped a foot into the room before being ambushed—muffled a strained voice from within Yuki’s chest.
“…Whaf ish this?”

“Hmm~?” Yuki hummed at her brother’s squashed voice, sliding down his body, burying her face into his neck while still clinging onto his torso. “I was just thinkin’ I’d teach Alya-san how our hugs work. Huggy huggy.”
“Don’t bite me.”
With his little sister still latched onto him, Masachika smacked the back of her head with an audible thwack.
Eh, “bite”…? Alisa chewed over his words, having noticed Masachika’s wince as Yuki sank her teeth into him. Wait, this feels like déjà vu…

Masachika being bitten, and on the neck at that. Such a combination sent her thoughts down memory lane as she furrowed her brow deeply… Recalling it all, she remembered how she had noticed the bite marks on Masachika’s neck from back when she had visited the Kuze household during the summer break.
Ah! she gasped as the realization hit her. So that was this sort of thing…

It was something that Masachika had simply brushed off as a result of fooling around with pro-wrestling moves at the time… But still, judging from the scene unfolding in front of her now, this kind of dynamic looked to be an everyday occurrence.

The sight of someone else throwing her whole entire body onto Masachika, the man she loved, pressing her lips against his neck. And worse still, the fact that the girl in front of her was doing it as a mere casual greeting.
【But he’s my partner…】 Alisa muttered quietly in Russian, pushed on by a small flame that seemed to flicker to life deep within her chest.
As if sensing that stir of emotion, Yuki turned her head while still clinging to Masachika.
“Ooooh, Alya-san’s jealousy sure is heavy,” she mocked, giving an exaggerated shiver before turning back to her brother and tacking on a lame pun. “Guess that makes you a heavysitter.”
“Quit making it sound like I’m some sorta weird babysitter.”
“But you are a real babysitter, y’knooow!?”
“I don’t need a baby this big.”
“Waaah, waaaaaahhh~” Yuki wailed, flailing around as she made baby-like cries while still clinging to her brother.
“D’you have like no sense of shame?” Masachika jested in exasperation.
With the whole scene leaving Alisa completely dumbfounded, Yuki set her hands on Masachika’s shoulders in the next moment, stretching her body backward into a deep arch.
“Whoa, careful…!”
With Masachika frantically leaning back in an effort to fight for his balance, she ended up staring straight at Alisa from a mildly mortifying upside down position.
“So yeah, it’s basically just this all day every day at our place. Think ya can handle that?”
“…Impossible,” Alisa answered in an instant, her voice devoid of any life.
“Let your guard down there, didn’tchaaaa?” Yuki grinned, letting her long black hair hang down toward the floor. “’Cause Alya-san, you never thought I’d show this side of myself at school, eh?”
With the nail having been hit on the head, Alisa could only catch her breath in surprise.

“Ya fool! I’m always lookin’ for any chance to get all lovey-dovey with Onii-chan!” Yuki declared with a triumphant smirk. “Didja really think I’d hold back around you just ’cause my true nature’s out, Alya-san!? What a shame! If ya can’t cut yourself into this sorta vibe, then there’s no room for you at all as long as I’m around!!!”
Her words were so rough that it actually made Alisa stagger a step back, flinching in shock to the type of provocation you’d only hear from a stereotypical yankee.
Snorting lightly in response, Yuki then raised herself back up, clinging onto Masachika again as she rested her shoulder on his chin.
“So yeah, I guess Onii-chan’s gotta marry Ayano at this point, hmmm~?”
“Eh!?” Alisa gasped lightly in response to Ayano being suddenly thrown into the mix.

“Wait, give me a sec…” Masachika let out a worn out voice on the other hand, seemingly not having the bandwidth to react. “You’re hitting me with way too much info here; it’s actually freaking me out. Seriously…”
“Just marry Ayano alreadyyy,” Yuki continued without a pause, ignoring the fact that she was completely overwhelming him. “Let the three of us live happily together forever, okay?”
Sharpening his expression in an instant, Masachika glanced toward the door behind him… Specifically, toward Ayano on the other side.
“Fufufu…” Yuki chuckled. “It sure sounds fun, y’know?”
Her softly whispered words left Masachika momentarily silent…
And yet, after a brief moment, he let out a small chuckle of his own, gently placing a hand on her back.
“…Yeah, maybe,” he agreed.
“Mhm.”
Before Alisa knew it, a warm little world had formed right in front of her, one that left her out entirely, and one where Masachika’s wife had been decided on without her.
In that instant… something snapped within her.
“I’ll do it,” Alisa declared.
“Hm?”
“Oh really?”

Marching straight toward the siblings who stared at her with equally puzzled expressions, Alisa grabbed Yuki by the scruff of her neck, practically yanking her off as she placed her hand firmly on Masachika’s shoulders with an intense gaze.
“Wh-whoa, what’s gotten into you?”
“I said I’ll do it…” Alisa gruffed. “That. That was how greetings are at the Suou family, wasn’t it?”

‘“No, no, no, that was obviously a lie!” Masachika exclaimed, frantically shaking his head with the realization of what she was about to attempt. “There’s no way you’d pull it off even if it wasn’t anyway, you know!? You’d fall, Alya!”
“What, are you saying I’m heavy!?”
“I mean, you’re heavier and bigger compared to Yuki, no!?”
“How rude!”
“But it’s true… I mean, sure, I might be able to manage it if I’m allowed to hold you by your legs here, but that’ll basically just make it—”
“The station bento position, hm? I get it,” Yuki interjected.
“Stop it!!!”
“Station bento…?” Alisa questioned. “What’s that supposed to mean?”
“Well, that’s…” Masachika stammered.
“What? Say it clearly already.”
“I can’t say it outright; it’s why it’s slang, y’know!?”
The two continued to bicker noisily, going back and forth. A moment in which Yuki could only watch from the sidelines.
“As I thought, you do like him, huh?” she murmured quietly under her breath.
Her voice, amused yet tinged with a small sense of loneliness, never reached the arguing duo.

tr: “Bu arada, nasıl bir kampanya vaat ediyorsun Alya-san?”

Öğrenci konseyi ofisindeki fiyaskonun üzerinden birkaç gün geçmişti. Dördü - yani Masachika, Alisa, Takeshi ve Hikaru - şu anda sınıfta öğle yemeklerini yiyorlardı ve ilk sohbeti başlatan Takeshi oldu.
“Kampanya vaat ediyor…?”

“Ah, hayır, sadece merak ediyorum, biliyor musun?” açıkladı. “Madem ikinci yarıyılın kapanış töreninde adaylardan konuşmalarında kampanya vaatlerine değinmeleri bekleniyor… Bu beni biraz meraklandırdı.”
Onun elini yüzünün önünde bunun arkasında daha derin bir anlam olmadığını söyler gibi salladığını gören Alisa düşüncelere daldı.
Her ne kadar böyle bir kapanış töreni geleneğini uzun zaman önce duymuş olsa da tam olarak ne söyleyeceğine hâlâ karar verememiş olduğu inkar edilemezdi.
Ne yapmalıyım…
Kelimeleri tam anlamıyla kaybetmişti.
“Bu konuda… Bak, bunu gerçek törende sabırsızlıkla beklenecek bir şey olarak düşün,” diye araya girdi Masachika, ona yardım etmek için yan taraftan atlayarak.
“Eee~? Gerçekten mi?”
“Ah, şu anki başkanın kampanya vaadi yazlık üniformaların değiştirilmesiyle ilgiliydi, değil mi?” Hikaru bunu fark etti.
Takeshi’nin sızlandığını duyunca Masachika’nın bakışını yakaladı ve hızla konunun değiştirilmesine yardım etti.
“Bu onun ana vaadiydi, öyle mi?” Masachika mırıldandı. “Sanırım aynı zamanda oldukça modası geçmiş şeylerde bir sürü küçük değişiklik yapmaktan da bahsetti…”

Takeshi’nin hemen yemi yuttuğunu gören Masachika, küçük bir gülümsemeyle omuz silkti.

“Evet. Aslında kendileri de başkan olmaktan çıkarılmadılar… Bir dakika, aslında şimdi düşünüyorum da, Raikoukai’ye katılamayacağın söyleniyor ama yine de sonuna kadar çalıştırılıyorlar kulağa oldukça kaba geliyor, değil mi?”
“Doğru…”
“Öyle değil mi? O noktada bu aslında sadece ücretsiz emek.”

“Hımm… Yanlış hatırlamıyorsam kampanya sözünü yerine getirememişlerdi. Sanırım ayrıntıları unuttum.”

“Ee, gerçekten mi?” Takeshi cıvıldadı. “Bunu ben bile bilmiyordum.”

“Evet. Yani… aslında sadece hafif müzik kulübü değildi, anlıyor musun?” Masachika ekledi. “Kulüp kurma gerekliliklerinin, en azından şimdikiyle karşılaştırıldığında, absürt derecede katı olduğu bir dönem vardı… Daha doğrusu, temelde imkansız bir oyun haldeydi, dolayısıyla düşündüğünüz başkan bu kısıtlamaların hafifletilmesi için kampanya yürüttü ve aslında sonunda bunu yaptı.”
“Ooooo.”
Masachika, Takeshi’ye daha ayrıntılı bir açıklama yaparken Alisa merakla başını eğdi. “Kulüp kurmak imkansızdı derken neyi kastediyorsun?”

İlki, “Annemle babamdan gerçekten böyle bir zamanın olduğunu duydum” dedi.

Masachika alaycı bir gülümsemeyle, “Ama artık kimsenin rock gruplarına karşı bu kadar önyargısı yok,” dedi. “Ne de olsa bu okul çağın gerisinde sanırım. Daha birkaç yıl öncesine kadar yasaklılardı falan.”
Omuz silkti.

“Evet… Dürüst olmak gerekirse benim bile neler olduğu hakkında hiçbir fikrim yoktu…” Hikaru ekledi. “Ama bunu gerçekten sakince hallettin, değil mi Alya-san?”

“T-teşekkür ederim…”

“Ha, gerçekten mi?” Alisa gözlerini hızla kırpıştırarak sordu.

“Eeee!?…Gerçekten mi?”
Sözleri Alisa’yı şaşırttı, kendini bunlara inandıramadı.

“Ah, ah, peki…”
Aslında Alisa gittiği her yerde öğrenci toplantısındaki davranışından dolayı sürekli övgüyle karşılandı, hatta birçoğu sıcak destek sözleri bile verdi.

Takeshi ve Hikaru’nun yalnızca sıcak biçimde gülümseyebildiği bir şeydi bu.
“İkinci yarıyılın kapanış töreninde seni gerçeklerle yüzleştirmemiz gerekecek, değil mi?” eskisi düşündü.
“Haha, şimdi öyle değil mi?” ikincisi kabul etti. “Alya-san sanırım şaşıracaksın, biliyor musun? Şu anda seni destekleyen bu kadar çok insan var.”
“…Gerçekten mi?”
Alisa’nın ürkek şüphesi bir kez daha ortaya çıkınca Takeshi ve Hikaru birbirlerine bakıp güldüler.
Ancak Hikaru aniden bir şeyi fark etmiş gibi Masachika’ya döndü…
“Ah doğru. Az önce bunu bir kenara bıraktık ama… sen oradaki o dehayı aramaktan mı bahsediyordun, amirite?”
“Hm? Ahhh… yani evet, sanırım.”
İlgiyle “Ooooh” diye mırıldandı. “Yani görünüşe bakılırsa yakalanmışlar falan, öyle mi? Değil mi… Onlara ulaşan Kimishima-san? Delil yetersizliğinden dolayı salıverildiklerini duydum…”

Her ne kadar resmi hikaye böyle olsa da, gerçek şu ki, gerçek deha hiçbir zaman yakalanmamıştı… Daha da önemlisi, o öğrenci toplantısı sırasında Alisa’ya komplo kurmaya çalışan diğer gerçek deha aslında Nonoa’ydı ve ne Hikaru’nun ne de Takeshi’nin bilmesine imkan yoktu.
Ve bunların hepsi Masachika’nın onlara söyleme niyetinde olmadığı bir şeydi.
“Evet, onun gibi bir şey,” diye düz bir yüzle başını salladı. “Ah, sadece söylüyorum ama tam olarak kim olduğu hakkında konuşamam, tamam mı?”
“Ah, sanırım bu bekleniyor?” Takeshi omuz silkerek söyledi.

“Hmm, anladım…” Hikaru da onu takip etti. “Ama dostum, bu gerçekten bilme isteği uyandırıyor amirite? Takeshi sersemlemiş bir sessizliğe gömüldü, farkına yeni varmış gibi defalarca gözlerini kırpıştırdı. “…Ha? Ah, öyle miydi yani?”

“Haha,” Hikaru yanıt olarak alaycı bir tavırla kıkırdadı. “Ama aslında olan da bu olmalı, değil mi? Bir öğrenci toplantısının aniden toplanması da: bu muhtemelen perde arkasında ipleri elinde tutan dehanın işiydi. Değil mi?”
“Huuuh!? Ahhh, anladım… Ohhh, demek böyleydi, ha…? Dostum, şimdi bu dehanın gerçekte kim olduğunu daha da merak ediyorum!”
Bunun üzerine Takeshi aniden Masachika’ya doğru atladı.
“Haydi, bana gizlice söyle, tamam mı?” sinsice fısıldadı ve elini ağzının hemen yanında kaldırdı. “Arkadaşlığın hatırı için!”
“Hiç şansım yok. Gizlilik yükümlülüklerim var, biliyor musun?”
“Aaaa! Gerçekten!? Çooook merak ediyorum!”

Takeshi’nin hem merak hem de muazzam bir tatminsizlikle kaşınarak kalbini açıkça koluna taktığını gören Masachika ve Alisa, Hikaru her şeyi boş bir şaşkınlık duygusuyla izlerken sadece bakışıp biraz acı-tatlı gülümsemeler bırakabildiler…
“Hey.”
“Hım?”

Artık yemek yemeyi bitirmişlerdi ve herkes öğleden sonra derslerine hazırlanıyordu. Alisa’nın sessizce kendisine seslendiğini duyan Masachika, hafifçe ona doğru eğilmeden önce öğretmenin hâlâ gelmediğini doğruladı.
“Naber?” diye sordu, fısıldayarak.
“Hımm, Nonoa-san ile ilgili…”
“…Ahhh.”
Sadece bu sözlerle ne demek istediğini tam olarak anlayan Masachika, kısa bir süre ön koltukta oturan Hikaru’ya baktı ve hızla başını iki yana salladı.
“Bunu onlara söylemeye gerek yok. Biz mutlu olsak bile kimsenin sonu mutlu olmayacak, öyle değil mi?”
“Evet… Öyle değil mi?”

Gerçekte, Nonoa’nın Takeshi ya da Hikaru’ya şüpheli bir şey yapma şansı şu anda oldukça düşüktü; asıl sorun, eğer gerçeği öğrenirlerse onun iki katına çıkma riskiydi. Muhtemelen Alisa’nın da anladığı bir mantık dizisiydi bu.

Demek istediğim, onun ikilemini anlamadığımı ve bu ikisini karanlıkta bırakmanın gerçekten sorun olup olmadığı hakkındaki şüphemi anlayamadığımı söyleyemem ama yine de… diye düşündü Masahika, partnerinin duygularını tamamen anlayarak.
Bilerek omuz silkti, ses tonu hafifti. “Demek istediğim, birisiyle iyi geçinmek için onun gerçek doğasını bilmenize gerek yok, anlıyor musunuz? Sen ve Yuki de öyleydiniz, değil mi?”
“Ah…! Bu doğru, değil mi?”
Anlaşılması kolay bir örnekle sunulan Alisa, küçük, alaycı bir gülümseme bıraktı.
Masachika ona gülümseyerek, “O halde, onlar için endişelenmeyin,” diye neşeyle devam etti. “Bak, devam et ve Takeshi’nin bahsettiği kampanya vaatlerini düşün.”
“Hey… benimle bu konuyu hiç düşünmüyormuşum gibi konuşulmasından hoşlanmıyorum, tamam mı?”
“Ohhh? Bu kadar mı?”
Öğretmen sınıfa girerken kendini yaslandığı pozisyondan geri çeken Masachika, ardından son bir açıklama daha ekledi.
“Eh, kapanış törenine neredeyse bir ay kaldı. Bu konuda düşünmekten çekinmeyin, tamam mı?”
Bu kadar rahatça sunulan bir öneri.
Ancak Masachika’nın bu düşünce tarzının ne kadar saf olduğunu anlaması yalnızca birkaç saatini alacaktı.
“Tamam o zaman, bunu piyano kulübünün varlığının devamına resmi olarak karar verildiği anlamına geliyor, değil mi?”
“Evet. Yani, minimumun altına düştükten sonra bir ay içinde üyelik numaralarını düzgünce geri aldılar, yani bu çok doğal, biliyorsun.”
Artık okul çıkışıydı. Öğrenci konseyi ofisinde toplanan üyeler, geçen haftaki yoğun öğrenci toplantısının ardından yaşananları tartışmaya başladı.
Uzun masanın başında her zamanki koltuğunda Başkan Touya oturuyordu.

“Her neyse, Chisaki ve sizin yürüttüğünüz o beyin avına gelince… Tıpkı Kuze’nin önerdiği gibi, bir şüphelinin yakalandığını ancak delil yetersizliğinden dolayı serbest bırakıldığını ve sonuç olarak kampüste daha fazla cadı avının durdurulduğunu duyurduk.”
Daha doğrusu, sanırım, tüm bu dolandırıcılık olayı görünüşe göre sadece seçimlerin bir parçası olarak görülüyormuş gibi görünmeye başlıyor.

“Ben de biraz araştırma yaptım,” diye araya girdi Chisaki. “En popüler teori, Alya-chan ve Yuki-chan dışında birinin sözde bir sonraki öğrenci konseyi başkanı olmayı hedeflediği ve görünüşe göre her iki çifti de aynı anda alt etmeye çalıştığı yönünde.”

“Haha, peki bu bu okula özgü bir davranış mı, amirite?” Masachika şaka yaptı ve üst sınıftaki iki öğrencisinin öğrencileri fazla kaygısız oldukları için sessizce yargıladıklarına yanıt olarak kuru bir kıkırdama verdi.

“…Evet.”
Bakışlarını yavaşça sorusundan uzaklaştıran Masachika, karşısında oturan Yuki ile bakıştı.

“Değerlendirmeniz için teşekkür ederiz…”
“Hiç de değil… Yine de gardınızı düşürmemeye dikkat edin; halıyı altınızdan çekip seçimden önce eleyebilirsiniz, anlıyor musunuz?”
Küçük bir gülümsemeyle başını sallayan Masachika, kıdemlisinin uyarı sözlerini kabul etti. “Evet anladım.”

Touya’nın oldukça gerçekçi endişesi karşısında kardeşinin yarı gülümsediğini gören Yuki, elini rahatça kaldırdı.

“Hm? Ohhh… Bu, ha? Tabii, devam et.”
“Çok teşekkür ederim.”
Hoş bir gülümsemeyle çantasından bazı belgeler çıkardı.
O proje…?
Ne demek istediğine dair en ufak bir fikri olmayan Masachika, gözlerini Yuki’nin uzattığı belgeye indirmeden önce yanındaki Alisa’ya birkaç kez baktı.
“Eh, bir Noel partisi…?” Kendisi de bir kopya alan Alisa şaşkınlığını dile getirdi.

Başka bir deyişle… bu tamamen yeni bir girişimdi.

Böyle gelişigüzel atılan bir bomba ve önündeki belgelerde yazılı içerikle karşı karşıya kalan Masachika, ifadesinin sertleştiğini hissetmekten kendini alamadı.
Vay, vay, vay, bu nedir…? sorusunu kendi kendine sordu. Ah, şimdi anlıyorum. Yani bu bizim için tam bir haber olsa da Başkan bunu zaten biliyordu, öyle mi?

Bunu ne kadar zamandır hazırladığına dair hiçbir fikrim yok ama… Tsk, bu çok güzel…

Düşüncelerini bir kenara bırakan Masachika, belgeleri incelemeye devam etti ve asıl etkinlik için gereken personelin işe alınmasının zaten halledildiğini ve bir yolunu bulup okul yönetiminden onay aldığını öğrendi.
Bu noktada proje zaten bu kadar somut olduğundan yapabileceği hiçbir şey yoktu.

Öyle olmasaydı, yine de “Kulağa çok zor geliyor; yardım etmeme izin verin, tamam mı?” gibi bir şeyle her şeyin organize edilmesine yardımcı olmaya zorlanabilirdi.
